definition_zh: 业余爱好者；外行；业余的；非专业的
definition_en: a person who does something for pleasure rather than as a profession; not professional
core_image: 周末才拿起画笔的人：不为钱，只为热爱
scene: 他白天是银行职员，周末却在公园写生。He is a devoted amateur painter who spends every weekend sketching in the park.
sceneCN: 这里的 amateur 是「业余的、非职业的」（第 2 个义项：业余的）；句意是他是个热忱的业余画家，每个周末都在公园写生，画画并非他的谋生职业。

derivatives.zh: 由 amateur 加后缀 -ish 构成，义为「笨拙的、业余水平的」，含贬义
由 amateur 加后缀 -ism 构成，义为「业余性；业余精神」
由 amateurish 加后缀 -ly 构成，义为「笨拙地、不熟练地」

senses.title: A person who loves an activity
senses.titleCN: 爱好者；喜爱某活动的人
senses.definition: a person who engages in an activity, especially a sport or art, out of love for it rather than for money
senses.definitionCN: 出于热爱而非金钱去从事某项活动（尤其是运动或艺术）的人
senses.example: As an amateur of chess, she studies every famous match.
senses.exampleCN: 作为国际象棋爱好者，她研究每一场名局。
senses.why: The word comes from French amateur, from Latin amator, meaning one who loves; the core image is doing something purely for love.
senses.whyCN: 该词来自法语 amateur，源自拉丁语 amator「爱慕者」，核心意象就是「为爱而做」，所以最早的义项指热爱某事的人。

senses.title: Doing something unpaid and non-professional
senses.definition: connected with an activity done for pleasure without payment, not as a job
senses.definitionCN: 指为乐趣而做、不取报酬、不作为职业的活动或身份
senses.example: The tournament is open to amateur players only.
senses.exampleCN: 这项赛事只对业余选手开放。
senses.why: Because amateurs do not take payment, the word naturally extends to describe the unpaid, non-professional side of any activity.
senses.whyCN: 由于爱好者不取报酬，这个词自然引申出「不领薪水的、非职业的」这一层意思，用来区分职业与业余领域。

senses.title: A person who is not skillful
senses.definition: a person who is incompetent or lacks the skill of a professional, often said with mild criticism
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏专业技能、做法不老练的人，常带轻微的批评意味
senses.example: He left the wiring looking like the work of an amateur.
senses.exampleCN: 他把线路装得像外行干的活。
senses.why: Skill usually follows paid practice; someone who only dabbles is therefore seen as clumsy, so the word drifted toward meaning a bungler.
senses.whyCN: 技能通常来自职业化的训练，只凭兴趣浅尝辄止的人容易被认为手艺粗糙，于是词义滑向「外行、笨手笨脚的人」。

senses.title: Lacking professional quality
senses.definition: describing work that is done in an unskillful or unprofessional way
senses.definitionCN: 形容做事方式不专业、水平粗糙，如业余级的作品或表现
senses.example: The report was criticized as an amateur attempt at analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告被批评为业余水平的分析。
senses.why: Once the word can describe the clumsy person, it can also describe the clumsy product of that person's hands.
senses.whyCN: 既然可以用这个词形容笨拙的人，也就能形容这种人做出来的粗糙成果，词义由人扩展到物。

intro.en: Amateur goes back to Latin amare, to love, through French amateur, one who loves.
intro.cn: amateur 源于拉丁语 amare「爱」，经法语 amateur「爱慕者」进入英语。

items.en: The reconstructed root *am- (some scholars write *em-) meant to hold or to love; the exact shape is uncertain.
items.cn: 重构词根 *am-（也有学者写作 *em-）表示「怀抱、爱」，具体形式存疑，一般认为与拉丁语 amare 同源。

items.en: Latin amare meant to love, and amator meant a lover or admirer.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amare 意为「爱」，派生名词 amator 意为「爱慕者、仰慕者」。

items.en: The word passed into French as amateur, meaning a lover or devotee of something.
items.cn: 该词进入法语写作 amateur，指某事物的爱好者、热心者。

items.en: English borrowed amateur around 1784, first meaning a devotee of an art or science.
items.cn: 英语约在 1784 年借入 amateur，最初指艺术或科学的爱好者。

items.en: Since amateurs were unpaid, the word came to mean non-professional, and later, by contrast with experts, a bungler.
items.cn: 因为爱好者不取报酬，词义发展为「非职业的」；后来与专家对照，又衍生出「外行、笨拙者」的贬义。

note.en: Amateur is often confused with amateurish, and contrasted with professional and expert.
note.cn: amateur 常与 amateurish 混淆，并与 professional、expert 形成对照。

entries.definition: unskillful; like the work of an amateur
entries.definitionCN: 笨拙的、业余水平的，由 amateur 派生的形容词，通常含贬义

entries.definition: the practice of doing something as an amateur
entries.definitionCN: 业余性；业余精神，由 amateur 加后缀 -ism 构成

entries.definition: relating to love or sexual desire
entries.definitionCN: 关于爱情的、表达爱欲的，与 amateur 同出拉丁语 amare，但词义 unrelated to skill

entries.definition: showing love or desire
entries.definitionCN: 多情的、含情脉脉的，同源于拉丁语 amare，只是拼写相近的另一分支

entries.definition: a person who takes part in an activity in a casual way
entries.definitionCN: 浅尝辄止的人、涉猎者，强调不深入，与外行义相近

entries.definition: a person without professional or specialist knowledge
entries.definitionCN: 门外汉、外行，强调缺乏专业知识背景

entries.definition: a beginner in an activity
entries.definitionCN: 新手、初学者，强调经验不足而非是否取酬

entries.definition: a person who earns money from an activity
entries.definitionCN: 职业者、专业人员，是业余义项的直接反义

entries.definition: a person with great skill or knowledge
entries.definitionCN: 专家、行家，与外行义相对

normalIntro.en: Use the Latin root of love and the French shape to remember amateur.
normalIntro.cn: 用「爱」的拉丁词根和法语拼写来记忆 amateur。

normal.en: amateur contains amat-, from Latin amare, to love.
normal.cn: amateur 含词根 amat-，来自拉丁语 amare「爱」。

normal.en: Amator in Latin literally means a lover.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 amator 字面意思就是「爱慕者」。

normal.en: Think of amor, the Latin word for love, hiding inside amateur.
normal.cn: 把拉丁语 amor（爱）想象成藏在 amateur 里面。

normal.en: amateur vs professional: the amateur plays for love, the pro for pay.
normal.cn: amateur 对 professional：业余者为爱而做，职业者为薪而做。

normal.en: amateurish adds -ish, meaning in the style of an amateur, hence clumsy.
normal.cn: amateurish 加后缀 -ish，表示「业余风格的」，引申为笨拙。

abstract.en: Picture a painter who paints every weekend purely out of love, never selling a canvas.
abstract.cn: 想象一位画者每个周末纯粹出于热爱作画，从不卖画。

abstract.en: See a Sunday footballer who plays for fun while professionals train all week.
abstract.cn: 想象一个周日踢球的爱好者，为乐趣奔跑，而职业球员整周都在训练。

abstract.en: Feel the gap between a loving heart and a practiced hand: love without pay is amateur.
abstract.cn: 感受「热忱的心」与「熟练的手」之间的落差：有爱无酬即是业余。

examples.en: She is an amateur photographer who sells none of her pictures.
examples.cn: 她是一名业余摄影师，从不售卖自己的照片。

examples.en: The wiring looked like the work of an amateur.
examples.cn: 线路安装得像外行的手艺。

examples.en: Amateur athletes once could not accept prize money.
examples.cn: 业余运动员曾经不能领取奖金。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱默特」——爱默默特着某个爱好的人，不图钱，只是喜欢，这就是业余爱好者；做得很差时就成了外行。

root: 拉丁词根 amat- / am- 表示「爱」，amare（爱）派生出 amator（爱慕者），经法语 amateur 进入英语。与 amatory（爱情的）、amorous（多情的）同族。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from a lover of an activity, through the unpaid non-professional sense, to a clumsy person and clumsy work.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「爱好者」出发，经「非职业的、业余的」，延伸到「外行的人」与「业余水平的成果」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: doing something purely for the love of it
core.cn: 核心意象：纯粹出于热爱去做一件事

branches.en: Loving an activity for its own sake
branches.cn: 为活动本身而热爱，即爱好者本义

branches.en: Unpaid activity and its unprofessional quality
branches.cn: 不取报酬的活动，及其带来的非专业水准

branches.en: The clumsy person behind dabbling
branches.cn: 浅尝辄止背后的笨拙之人，即外行

branches.en: Contrast with professionals who train and are paid
branches.cn: 与受训取酬的职业者形成对照

branches.en: The product of unskillful hands
branches.cn: 笨拙之手做出的粗糙成果

intro.en: Amateur shows the Latin love root amat- plus a French agent ending.
intro.cn: amateur 展示了拉丁语「爱」词根 amat- 加上法语施动者词尾的结构。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives built on amare, to love.
latinIntro.cn: 建立在拉丁语 amare（爱）之上的同源词。

definition_zh: 大使；使节；代表人物
definition_en: an official envoy who represents his or her country abroad; a person who represents or promotes something
core_image: 身负国书、站在异国宫廷里的国家代言人
scene: 她在友好条约签署仪式上递交国书。The ambassador presented her credentials at the signing ceremony of the friendship treaty.
sceneCN: 这里的 ambassador 是「大使」（第 1 个义项：国家正式派驻的外交使节）；句意是这位大使在友好条约签署仪式上递交了国书。

derivatives.zh: 由 ambassador 加后缀 -ial 构成，义为「大使的、大使级地位的」
由 ambassador 加阴性后缀 -ess 构成，义为「女大使；大使夫人」，现较少用
与 ambassador 同源（经古法语 embassator），义为「大使馆；使团」

senses.title: An official diplomatic envoy
senses.definition: the highest-ranking diplomatic representative sent by one country to live and work in another
senses.definitionCN: 一国派驻另一国的最高级别外交代表，常驻对方首都
senses.example: The French ambassador attended the state dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 法国大使出席了国宴。
senses.why: The word originally means one sent on a mission; the highest such messenger became the resident chief representative between states.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本义是「受命出使的人」；级别最高的使节逐渐固定为常驻两国之间的首席代表，即大使。

senses.title: A special representative for a cause
senses.definition: a person appointed to represent or promote a organization, activity, or idea
senses.definitionCN: 被指定代表或推广某组织、活动、理念的人，如亲善大使、品牌大使
senses.example: She became a goodwill ambassador for the children's fund.
senses.exampleCN: 她成为该儿童基金会的亲善大使。
senses.why: A diplomat represents a nation; by analogy, anyone who speaks and stands for a cause is called its ambassador.
senses.whyCN: 外交官代表国家；以此类推，凡为某事业出面发声、树立形象的人，也被称为这项事业的「大使」。

senses.title: An informal unofficial representative
senses.definition: a person who spreads a culture, image, or idea wherever he or she goes, without formal appointment
senses.definitionCN: 未经正式任命、走到哪里都在传播某种文化或形象的人
senses.example: Good food is a great ambassador for a country's culture.
senses.exampleCN: 美食是一个国家文化的绝佳传播使者。
senses.why: Just as an envoy carries messages across borders, food, music, or a charming person carries culture across borders informally.
senses.whyCN: 正如使节跨越国界传递信息，美食、音乐或有魅力的人也在非正式地跨越国界传播文化，故引申为「传播者」。

intro.en: Ambassador traces to a Celtic-Latin-Germanic blend via Old French embassator, one sent on a mission.
intro.cn: ambassador 源头较复杂，一般认为混合凯尔特与日耳曼成分，经古法语 embassator（受命出使之人）进入英语。

items.en: The reconstructed root *bheudh- or a Celtic base *ambactos meant one going around to serve; the exact chain is debated.
items.cn: 重构词根 *bheudh- 或凯尔特词基 *ambactos 表示「四出奔走服役者」，演变链条存在争议，一般作存疑处理。

items.en: Late Latin ambactus and ambiguus-influenced forms meant servant or messenger.
items.cn: 后期拉丁语 ambactus 及相关形式表示「仆从、信使」。

items.en: Old French embassator and embassy-related forms meant one charged with a mission.
items.cn: 古法语 embassator 及 embassy 一族词形表示「负使命者」。

items.en: English adopted ambassador in the late 14th century for envoys between rulers.
items.cn: 英语于 14 世纪末采用 ambassador，指君主之间的正式使者。

items.en: With resident diplomacy after the Renaissance, the word settled as the top permanent envoy, then spread to symbolic representatives.
items.cn: 文艺复兴后常驻外交兴起，词义固定为常驻最高使节，后扩展到象征性的代表人物。

note.en: Ambassador is confused with embassy and contrasted with envoy, diplomat and consul.
note.cn: ambassador 易与 embassy 混淆，并与 envoy、diplomat、consul 相对。

entries.definition: the official residence or office of an ambassador
entries.definitionCN: 大使馆；使馆全体人员，与 ambassador 同出一族

entries.definition: relating to an ambassador
entries.definitionCN: 大使的；大使级的，由 ambassador 派生

entries.definition: a female ambassador or an ambassador's wife
entries.definitionCN: 女大使；大使夫人，旧式阴性形式

entries.definition: the act of going on board a ship or plane
entries.definitionCN: 登船；登机，与 ambassador 只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a messenger or representative sent on a mission
entries.definitionCN: 使节、特使，级别通常略低于大使

entries.definition: an official engaged in international negotiations
entries.definitionCN: 外交官，泛指从事外交的人员

entries.definition: an official appointed to protect citizens' interests abroad
entries.definitionCN: 领事，负责侨民与签证事务，非国家元首级代表

entries.definition: a person sent to represent others at a meeting
entries.definitionCN: 代表、 delegate 强调受派出席会议

entries.definition: a junior member of an embassy staff
entries.definitionCN: 使馆随员，级别低于大使的专员

normalIntro.en: Split ambassador into am-bass-ador to hold the spelling.
normalIntro.cn: 把 ambassador 拆成 am-bass-ador 来记拼写。

normal.en: The family words are ambassador, embassy, embassage.
normal.cn: 同族词有 ambassador、embassy、embassage。

normal.en: One m in embassy but double m in ambassador.
normal.cn: embassy 只有一个 m，ambassador 有两个 m。

normal.en: -ador is the Spanish-shaped agent ending, meaning one who acts.
normal.cn: -ador 是西班牙语风格的施动者词尾，表示「做某事的人」。

normal.en: an ambassador TO a country, not of.
normal.cn: 搭配用 ambassador to a country，表示驻某国大使。

normal.en: goodwill ambassador extends the word beyond diplomacy.
normal.cn: goodwill ambassador 把这个词扩展到了外交之外的领域。

abstract.en: Picture an ambassador carrying a sealed letter from one throne to another.
abstract.cn: 想象大使携一封密封国书，从一个王庭走向另一个王庭。

abstract.en: See a football star wearing a brand logo wherever he lands: a walking ambassador.
abstract.cn: 想象球星走到哪里都带着品牌标志，是一座行走的大使牌。

abstract.en: Feel how a national dish travels the world ahead of any diplomat.
abstract.cn: 感受一道国民美食先于任何外交官走遍世界。

examples.en: The two countries exchanged ambassadors last year.
examples.cn: 两国去年互派了大使。

examples.en: She serves as a goodwill ambassador for the environment.
examples.cn: 她担任环境领域的亲善大使。

examples.en: Every tourist is, in a sense, an ambassador of his homeland.
examples.cn: 每个游客在某种意义上都是祖国的形象使者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺怕使节的」——俺国最怕（不敢怠慢）使节的那个人就是大使；ambassador 是两国之间最体面的传话人。

root: 一般认为源自凯尔特语 *ambactos「四出奔走者」，经后期拉丁语与古法语 embassator（负使命之人）进入英语；与 embassy 同族。词源链条存在学术争议。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the resident diplomatic chief, to an appointed representative of a cause, to any informal carrier of an image.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「常驻外交大使」出发，扩展到「公益或品牌的正式使者」，再引申为「无任命的形象传播者」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one person sent across a border to speak for the whole
core.cn: 核心意象：一人跨越边界，代表全体发声

branches.en: The state-appointed envoy residing abroad
branches.cn: 国家任命、常驻他国的使节

branches.en: From representing a nation to representing a cause
branches.cn: 从代表国家扩展到代表某项事业

branches.en: Formal goodwill and brand promotion
branches.cn: 正式的亲善与品牌推广角色

branches.en: Informal carriers of culture and image
branches.cn: 文化形象的非正式传播者

branches.en: The person becomes a living symbol
branches.cn: 使者的身份升华为活的象征

intro.cn: ambassador 带有古老的凯尔特「奔走服役」词基，并缀有法语施动者词尾。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin ambactus, servant or messenger, anchors the family.
latinIntro.cn: 后期拉丁语 ambactus（仆从、信使）是这一词族的锚点。

definition_zh: 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；有歧义的
definition_en: open to more than one interpretation; not clear or decided
core_image: 叉路口的路标：同时指向两个方向
scene: 老师批复只写了一个「好」，学生猜不出是称赞还是敷衍。The teacher's reply was so ambiguous that no one knew whether it was praise or dismissal.
sceneCN: 这里的 ambiguous 是「模棱两可的」（第 1 个义项：可作多种解释）；句意是老师的回复含糊其辞，没人知道是称赞还是敷衍。

derivatives.zh: 由 ambiguous 加后缀 -ity 构成，义为「歧义；模棱两可」
由 ambiguous 加后缀 -ly 构成，义为「含糊地；歧义地」
由否定前缀 un- 加 ambiguous 构成，义为「明确的、毫不含糊的」

senses.title: Having more than one possible meaning
senses.titleCN: 有歧义的；可作多种解释的
senses.definition: having or expressing more than one possible meaning, so the reader must guess
senses.definitionCN: 具有或表达出不止一种可能的含义，使读者不得不猜测
senses.example: The sentence is ambiguous without a comma.
senses.exampleCN: 没有逗号，这个句子就有歧义。
senses.why: Latin ambigere means to wander around; a meaning that wanders between two readings is ambiguous.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ambigere 意为「四处游走」；含义在两种解读之间游移不定，正是歧义的本义。

senses.title: Not clear or deliberate in intention
senses.titleCN: 含糊其辞的；意向不明的
senses.definition: not stating a position clearly, often on purpose to keep options open
senses.definitionCN: 不明说立场，常为了保留回旋余地而故意含糊
senses.example: The spokesman gave an ambiguous reply about the merger.
senses.exampleCN: 发言人对并购一事给了个含糊其辞的答复。
senses.why: When a speaker refuses to settle on one meaning, the wandering meaning becomes deliberate vagueness.
senses.whyCN: 当说话者不肯在一种含义上安定下来，「游移的含义」就变成了有意为之的含糊。

senses.title: Mixed in character or feeling
senses.titleCN: 难以定性的；正邪难辨的
senses.definition: having two opposite qualities at once, such as good and bad, so the moral reading is unclear
senses.definitionCN: 同时具有两种对立性质（如善与恶），使人难以作出单一评价
senses.example: The hero of the film is a morally ambiguous figure.
senses.exampleCN: 影片的主人公是个道德上难以定性的人物。
senses.why: If meaning can wander, so can judgment; a person of two faces lets the moral reading wander too.
senses.whyCN: 既然含义可以游移，评价也可以游移；具有两副面孔的人物让道德判断悬而未决。

intro.en: Ambiguous comes from Latin ambigere, to wander around, from ambi- both ways plus agere to drive.
intro.cn: ambiguous 来自拉丁语 ambigere「四处游走」，由 ambi-（两边）+ agere（驱动）构成。

items.en: The root *ag- meant to drive or move; *ambhi- meant around.
items.cn: 词根 *ag- 表示「驱动、移动」；*ambhi- 表示「周围、两边」。

items.en: Latin ambi- meant both ways, and ambigere meant to wander around or waver.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ambi- 表示「两边」，ambigere 表示「游走、摇摆」。

items.en: The adjective ambiguus described anything unsettled or open to two readings.
items.cn: 拉丁语形容词 ambiguus 描述一切悬而未决、可作两解的事物。

items.en: English adopted ambiguous around 1520 for doubtful and uncertain statements.
items.cn: 英语约在 1520 年借入 ambiguous，用于表示可疑、不明确的表述。

items.en: The word now covers verbal ambiguity, deliberate vagueness, and morally mixed characters.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖语言歧义、有意含糊以及道德上的正邪难辨。

note.en: Ambiguous overlaps with vague and equivocal, and opposes explicit and unambiguous.
note.cn: ambiguous 与 vague、equivocal 意义交错，与 explicit、unambiguous 相对。

entries.definition: able to use both hands equally well
entries.definitionCN: 双手都灵巧的，同用前缀 ambi-（两边），但词根不同

entries.definition: having mixed feelings about something
entries.definitionCN: 情感矛盾的，同用 ambi-（两边），指内心态度而非语句含义

entries.definition: the scope or extent of something
entries.definitionCN: 范围、界限，与 ambiguous 只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a vehicle for carrying sick people
entries.definitionCN: 救护车，同源于 ambi- 一族的 wandering，但词义已完全分化，只是拼写相近

entries.definition: not clear in shape or meaning
entries.definitionCN: 模糊的，强调轮廓或含义不清晰

entries.definition: open to two interpretations, often deceptively
entries.definitionCN: 歧义的、闪烁其词的，常含故意误导之意

entries.definition: not clearly expressed or easily understood
entries.definitionCN: 晦涩的、费解的，强调难以理解而非多义

entries.definition: stated clearly and in detail
entries.definitionCN: 明确的、清楚的，直接反义

entries.definition: having only one possible meaning
entries.definitionCN: 毫不含糊的，由 ambiguous 加否定前缀构成的反义

normalIntro.en: Hold the prefix ambi- plus the root of driving to keep ambiguous straight.
normalIntro.cn: 抓住前缀 ambi- 加上「驱动」词根，就能记住 ambiguous。

normal.en: ambi- means both ways, as in ambidextrous and ambivalent.
normal.cn: ambi- 表示「两边」，也见于 ambidextrous、ambivalent。

normal.en: agere means to drive; ambiguous meaning is driven two ways.
normal.cn: agere 表示「驱动」；歧义就是含义被驱向两个方向。

normal.en: the noun is ambiguity, with -ity ending.
normal.cn: 名词是 ambiguity，以 -ity 结尾。

normal.en: unambiguous simply blocks both ways, leaving one.
normal.cn: unambiguous 用否定前缀封掉一个方向，只剩一种含义。

normal.en: ambivalent is about feelings, ambiguous about meanings.
normal.cn: ambivalent 说的是心情矛盾，ambiguous 说的是含义多解。

abstract.en: See a road sign pointing left and right at once, promising both directions.
abstract.cn: 想象一块同时指向左右的标牌，承诺两个方向。

abstract.en: Picture a diplomat smiling and saying nothing definite at a press conference.
abstract.cn: 想象发言人在发布会上微笑着却不给一句确定的话。

abstract.en: Feel a coin spinning on the table: neither heads nor tails while it turns.
abstract.cn: 感受旋转中的硬币：转动时既非正面也非反面。

examples.en: His ambiguous answer satisfied nobody.
examples.cn: 他模棱两可的回答谁也不满意。

examples.en: The word carry is ambiguous between transport and support.
examples.cn: carry 一词在「运输」和「支撑」之间有歧义。

examples.en: The contract was rewritten to remove every ambiguous clause.
examples.cn: 合同被重写，删去了所有含糊的条款。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺必给由」——俺必定给你由你猜：一句话两种解，任你怎么猜都行，这就是模棱两可。

root: 拉丁前缀 ambi-（两边、周围）+ 词根 ag-（驱动、移动），ambigere 即「在两边之间摇摆」，形容词 ambiguus 表示「可作两解的」。同族词有 ambivalent、ambidextrous。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from double meaning, to deliberate vagueness, to mixed moral character.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「一语双关的多义」出发，经「故意含糊」，延伸到「正邪难辨的复杂品性」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a meaning that wanders between two readings
core.cn: 核心意象：在两种解读之间游移不定的含义

branches.en: One sentence, several readings
branches.cn: 一句话多种解读，即语言歧义

branches.en: From accident to strategy in not being clear
branches.cn: 从无意歧义到有意保留模糊

branches.en: Vagueness used to keep options open
branches.cn: 以含糊保留回旋余地

branches.en: Judgment itself becomes double-edged
branches.cn: 评价本身变得两面难断

branches.en: Unclear position and unclear character reinforce each other
branches.cn: 立场不明与品性难辨互为表里

intro.en: Ambiguous is built on ambi- both ways plus ag- to drive.
intro.cn: ambiguous 由 ambi-（两边）加 ag-（驱动）构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives of ambi- and ag-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ambi- 与 ag- 的同族词。

derivatives.zh: 歧义；模棱两可
含糊地；歧义地
明确的；毫不含糊的

definition_zh: 有雄心的；野心勃勃的；规模宏大的
definition_en: having a strong desire for success or achievement; requiring great effort
core_image: 盯着山顶不肯回头望的登山者
scene: 她刚毕业就计划三年内开十家分店。The ambitious young manager planned to open ten branch stores within three years.
sceneCN: 这里的 ambitious 是「有雄心的」（第 1 个义项：渴求成功）；句意是这位雄心勃勃的年轻经理计划三年内开出十家分店。

pos.zh: 有雄心的；野心勃勃的；宏大的

derivatives.zh: 由 ambitious 还原的名词形式，义为「雄心；抱负；野心」
由 ambitious 加后缀 -ly 构成，义为「雄心勃勃地」
由 over- 加 ambitious 构成，义为「野心过大而不切实际的」

senses.title: Strongly desiring success
senses.definition: having a strong desire to achieve success, power, or a high position
senses.definitionCN: 强烈渴望取得成功、权力或高位
senses.example: An ambitious student, she aimed for the top law school.
senses.exampleCN: 她是个有雄心的学生，目标直指顶尖法学院。
senses.why: Ambire in Latin means to go around canvassing votes; the image of someone moving eagerly toward a goal became the desire to rise.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ambire 意为「四处奔走拉票」；那种朝着目标积极奔走的画面，固化成了「渴望向上爬」的词义。

senses.title: Demanding great effort or resources
senses.titleCN: 规模宏大的；需要巨大投入的
senses.definition: describing a plan or goal that is large in scale and hard to achieve
senses.definitionCN: 形容计划或目标规模宏大、实现难度高
senses.example: The bridge was the most ambitious engineering project of its age.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥是那个时代最宏大的工程项目。
senses.why: A person full of desire sets goals larger than ordinary ones; the word then transfers from the desiring person to the oversized goal.
senses.whyCN: 欲望强烈的人定的目标往往超出常规；词义便从「有欲望的人」转移到「超常的目标」上。

senses.title: Eager in a negative, self-seeking way
senses.titleCN: 野心勃勃的；不择手段的（贬义）
senses.definition: having so strong a desire for power or success that honesty or others' interests may be sacrificed
senses.definitionCN: 对权力或成功的渴望强烈到可能牺牲诚信或他人利益
senses.example: His ambitious scheming cost him old friends.
senses.exampleCN: 他野心勃勃的算计让他失去了老朋友。
senses.why: Canvassing for votes edges toward manipulation; desire pushed past fairness turns ambition into scheming.
senses.whyCN: 拉票本就带有操纵意味；欲望越过公平的界限，雄心便滑向「钻营算计」的贬义。

intro.en: Ambitious comes from Latin ambire, to go around, the image of Roman candidates canvassing for votes.
intro.cn: ambitious 源于拉丁语 ambire「四处奔走」，其意象正是罗马候选人四处拉票。

items.en: The roots *ambhi- around and *eigh- to move combine in the sense of going about.
items.cn: 词根 *ambhi-（周围）与 *eigh-（移动）组合成「四处走动」之义。

items.en: Latin ambire meant to go around; ambitio meant a canvassing for office.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ambire 意为「四处走动」；ambitio 特指谋求官职时的拉票活动。

items.en: Old French ambicion kept the sense of desire for rank.
items.cn: 古法语 ambicion 保留了对位分的渴求之义。

items.en: English ambition first meant eager striving for honor, often with a negative shade.
items.cn: 英语 ambition 最初指对荣誉的急切追逐，常带贬义。

items.en: The adjective ambitious now praises drive as often as it warns against greed, and also describes huge undertakings.
items.cn: 现代形容词 ambitious 既赞许进取心也警示贪欲，还可形容规模浩大的事业。

note.en: Ambitious stands between aspiring and grasping, and pairs with its noun ambition.
note.cn: ambitious 介于褒义的 aspiring 与贬义的 grasping 之间，与其名词 ambition 配套。

entries.definition: the atmosphere of a place
entries.definitionCN: 环境气氛，与 ambitious 只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: open to more than one meaning
entries.definitionCN: 歧义的，同用 ambi-（两边）前缀，但词义无关

entries.definition: surrounding on all sides
entries.definitionCN: 周围的、环境的，同用 ambi-（两边）词根，但与「雄心」义完全无关

entries.definition: lacking ambition
entries.definitionCN: 没有雄心的，由 ambition 加 -less 构成

entries.definition: directing one's hopes toward a goal
entries.definitionCN: 有志向的，褒义色彩更浓

entries.definition: showing initiative and willingness to take risks
entries.definitionCN: 有进取心的、敢闯的，强调行动力

entries.definition: relentlessly motivated
entries.definitionCN: 发奋的、有内驱力的

entries.definition: greedy for gain
entries.definitionCN: 贪得无厌的，对应贬义义项

entries.definition: satisfied with what one has
entries.definitionCN: 知足的、安分的，反义对照

normalIntro.en: Link ambitious to ambition and the Latin image of going around.
normalIntro.cn: 把 ambitious 与 ambition 及拉丁语「四处奔走」的画面连起来记。

normal.en: ambitious is simply ambition plus the adjective ending -ous.
normal.cn: ambitious 就是 ambition 加形容词后缀 -ous。

normal.en: Latin ambire, to go around, is behind both words.
normal.cn: 两个词都出自拉丁语 ambire「四处走动」。

normal.en: Roman candidates literally went around asking for votes.
normal.cn: 罗马候选人字面上就是四处奔走求票。

normal.en: overambitious warns that the goal overshot the means.
normal.cn: overambitious 警示目标超出了手段。

normal.en: be ambitious FOR someone means wanting success on their behalf.
normal.cn: be ambitious for someone 表示为某人抱有期望。

abstract.en: See a climber who refuses to check the view because only the summit exists.
abstract.cn: 想象一位登山者无暇看风景，因为眼里只有山顶。

abstract.en: Picture blueprints on a wall that show ten stores instead of one.
abstract.cn: 想象墙上钉着的设计图，不是一家店而是十家店的蓝图。

abstract.en: Feel the hairline between fire in the heart and fire that burns others.
abstract.cn: 感受心中之火与灼伤他人之火之间那条细线。

examples.en: She is ambitious and studies late every night.
examples.cn: 她雄心勃勃，每晚都学习到深夜。

examples.en: Launching the magazine in six months was an ambitious plan.
examples.cn: 六个月内创办杂志是个雄心勃勃的计划。

examples.en: The plot was driven by an ambitious general.
examples.cn: 这场阴谋是由一个野心勃勃的将军推动的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺必胜」——俺必定要胜过所有人，胸中燃着这把火的人就是 ambitious：有雄心的，甚至野心勃勃。

root: 拉丁语 ambi-（周围）+ ire（走），ambire 意为「四处奔走」；名词 ambitio 最初指候选人拉票求官，后泛指对功名的追逐。同族词 ambition、ambience。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from personal drive, through oversized undertakings, to ruthless self-seeking.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「个人的上进心」出发，经「规模宏大的事业」，延伸到「不择手段的野心」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: climbing hard because only the summit matters
core.cn: 核心意象：因为只在乎山顶而拼命攀登

branches.en: The inner fire to rise
branches.cn: 渴望上升的内心之火

branches.en: Grand goals born from grand desire
branches.cn: 宏大的欲望孕育宏大的目标

branches.en: Projects that dwarf ordinary plans
branches.cn: 令寻常计划相形见绌的工程

branches.en: Desire crossing from drive into scheming
branches.cn: 欲望从进取滑向钻营

branches.en: Others sacrificed on the way up
branches.cn: 攀登途中被牺牲的他人

intro.en: Ambitious joins ambi- around, the motion of ire, and the adjective ending -ous.
intro.cn: ambitious 由 ambi-（周围）、表移动的 ire 词根和形容词后缀 -ous 组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin ambire and ambitio carry the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ambire 与 ambitio 支撑起整个词族。

derivatives.zh: 雄心；抱负
雄心勃勃地
野心过大而不切实际的

definition_zh: 救护车；救护船；救护飞机
definition_en: a special vehicle equipped to carry sick or injured people to hospital
core_image: 鸣笛开道、载着病人的白色车辆
scene: 路口的车纷纷靠边让行。An ambulance rushed through the traffic with its siren wailing.
sceneCN: 这里的 ambulance 是「救护车」（第 1 个义项：运送伤病者的专用车辆）；句意是救护车鸣着笛冲过车流。

derivatives.zh: 同源形容词（经拉丁 ambulare），义为「能走动的、流动的」，如 ambulant clinic 流动诊所
由 ambulare 词族派生，义为「可走动的；不需卧床的」
与 ambulance 同源（拉丁 ambulare），义为「缓行、从容漫步」

senses.title: A vehicle for carrying the sick or injured
senses.definition: a specially equipped vehicle that carries sick or injured people to hospital quickly
senses.definitionCN: 经过专门装备、能快速把伤病者送往医院的车辆
senses.example: Call an ambulance; his breathing is shallow.
senses.exampleCN: 快叫救护车，他呼吸微弱。
senses.why: The word means a walking hospital; the modern vehicle is the mobile ward that lets treatment travel to the patient.
senses.whyCN: 该词本义是「流动的医院」；现代救护车就是移动的病房，让医疗主动走向病人。

senses.title: A ship or aircraft for the same duty
senses.definition: a ship or aircraft equipped to transport and treat the wounded
senses.definitionCN: 装备了救护条件、用于运送和救治伤员的船只或飞机
senses.example: The navy deployed an air ambulance to the island.
senses.exampleCN: 海军向该岛派出了救护飞机。
senses.why: Once the word means mobile medical care, any vehicle that carries it, on sea or in air, inherits the name.
senses.whyCN: 既然词义是「移动医疗」，那么凡能在海上或空中承担此责的载具也就继承了这名称。

senses.title: A mobile medical unit or team
senses.definition: a mobile unit or organized team that gives emergency care, especially in war or disaster
senses.definitionCN: 提供急救的流动单位或成建制团队，多见于战争或灾害场景
senses.example: Volunteers formed a field ambulance near the front line.
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者在前线附近组建了一支战地救护队。
senses.why: The core idea of medicine on the move predates the vehicle; a walking team of medics is an ambulance in the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 「移动的医疗」这一核心观念早于车辆本身；一支步行机动的医疗队正是 ambulance 最古老的意义。

intro.en: Ambulance comes from Latin ambulare, to walk, through the French hopital ambulant, a walking hospital.
intro.cn: ambulance 源于拉丁语 ambulare「行走」，经由法语的 hopital ambulant（流动医院）得名。

items.en: The reconstructed root *h2elbh- or *ambh- relates to movement; the exact chain is uncertain.
items.cn: 重构词根与「移动」相关（*ambh- 一说），演变链条细节存疑。

items.en: Latin ambulare meant to walk or stroll.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ambulare 意为「行走、漫步」。

items.en: French formed hopital ambulant, a moving field hospital, shortened to ambulance.
items.cn: 法语造出 hopital ambulant（随军流动医院），后缩略为 ambulance。

items.en: English took ambulance in the mid-19th century for mobile military medical units.
items.cn: 英语在 19 世纪中叶借入 ambulance，最初指军队的流动医疗单位。

items.en: With motor transport the word shifted to the vehicle itself, then to air and sea variants.
items.cn: 机动车辆普及后，词义转移到车辆本身，随后又扩展到空中与海上救护载具。

note.en: Ambulance walks a path shared with amble and ambulatory; do not confuse it with ambassador.
note.cn: ambulance 与 amble、ambulatory 同走「行走」一路；勿与 ambassador 混淆。

entries.definition: able to walk; not confined to bed
entries.definitionCN: 可走动的、不需卧床的，与 ambulance 同出 ambulare

entries.definition: walking; moving from place to place
entries.definitionCN: 走动的、流动的，英国用法，同源于 ambulare

entries.definition: to walk in a slow relaxed way
entries.definitionCN: 缓行、漫步，同源动词

entries.definition: a surprise attack from a hidden position
entries.definitionCN: 伏击，只是拼写相近，词源完全不同

entries.definition: the transport of patients by aircraft
entries.definitionCN: 医疗后送（常指直升机），与救护飞机义近

entries.definition: a frame for carrying an injured person
entries.definitionCN: 担架，同为转运伤员的工具

entries.definition: a person trained to give emergency medical care
entries.definitionCN: 急救医助，常随救护车出动

entries.definition: a place providing medical treatment
entries.definitionCN: 诊所，固定医疗点与移动救护相对

entries.definition: a special emergency vehicle
entries.definitionCN: 消防车，同为鸣笛应急的特种车辆

normalIntro.en: Remember ambulance as the hospital that walks to you.
normalIntro.cn: 把 ambulance 记成「向你走来的医院」。

normal.en: the root ambul- means walk, as in amble.
normal.cn: 词根 ambul- 表示「行走」，同 amble。

normal.en: French hopital ambulant means walking hospital.
normal.cn: 法语 hopital ambulant 即「流动医院」。

normal.en: ambulance is that walking hospital shrunk to one word.
normal.cn: ambulance 就是把「流动医院」缩成一个词。

normal.en: ambulant and ambulatory keep the walking sense in medicine.
normal.cn: ambulant 与 ambulatory 在医学里保留「可走动」之义。

normal.en: field ambulance survives as a military medical unit.
normal.cn: field ambulance 至今仍指军队的医疗单位。

abstract.en: Picture a hospital packing itself onto wheels and driving to the patient.
abstract.cn: 想象一座医院把自己装上车轮，开到病人身边。

abstract.en: See the white vehicle clearing a path through stuck traffic.
abstract.cn: 想象白色车身在拥堵车流中开辟出一条通道。

abstract.en: Feel the urgency: the walking hospital must not stop walking.
abstract.cn: 感受紧迫感：这座「流动医院」一刻也不能停下脚步。

examples.en: An ambulance arrived within five minutes.
examples.cn: 救护车五分钟内就赶到了。

examples.en: The wounded were flown out by air ambulance.
examples.cn: 伤员由救护飞机运出。

examples.en: She works as an ambulance driver on night shifts.
examples.cn: 她上夜班，担任救护车司机。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺不能死」——俺不能死，快叫救护车！病人最急的一句话，正好挂在 ambulance 上。

root: 拉丁词根 ambul- 表示「行走」（ambulare 行走），法语 hopital ambulant「流动医院」缩略为 ambulance。同族词有 amble（缓行）、ambulatory（可走动的）。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the road vehicle, to air and sea medical transport, to mobile medical units.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「公路救护车」出发，扩展到「海空救护载具」，再回溯到「流动医疗单位」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hospital that walks to the patient
core.cn: 核心意象：主动走向病人的医院

branches.en: The road vehicle that races time
branches.cn: 与时间赛跑的救护车辆

branches.en: The same duty carried onto sea and air
branches.cn: 同一使命延伸到海与空

branches.en: Aircraft and ships as flying hospitals
branches.cn: 作为飞行医院或浮动医院的载具

branches.en: People on foot forming the original ambulance
branches.cn: 徒步的救护队是最早的 ambulance

branches.en: Mobile care wherever fixed hospitals cannot go
branches.cn: 固定医院到不了之处，移动医疗到达

intro.en: Ambulance is built on the Latin walking root ambul- plus a noun ending.
intro.cn: ambulance 建立在拉丁语「行走」词根 ambul- 加名词词尾之上。

latinIntro.en: Latin ambulare supports the whole walking family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ambulare 支撑整个「行走」词族。

derivatives.zh: 流动的；可走动的
不需卧床的；可步行的

definition_zh: 数量；总额；合计；等同
definition_en: the total number or quantity of something; to add up to or be equal to
core_image: 汇入同一容器的流水，最终读出总量刻度
scene: 月底他对着账单发呆，支出比想象的多。The total amount of his expenses surprised him at the end of the month.
sceneCN: 这里的 amount 是「总额」（第 1 个义项：合计的量）；句意是月底看到支出的总额时他吃了一惊。

derivatives.zh: 由 amount 加后缀 -able 构成，义为「可计量的」，较罕用
由同根动词 mount 加 -ing 派生，义为「底座；日益增高的量」，如 the mounting costs

senses.title: The total quantity of something
senses.definition: the total number or quantity of something, especially measured as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 某物的总量或总数，尤指作为整体计量（如钱、时间等不可数物）
senses.example: The amount of money in the account doubled.
senses.exampleCN: 账户里的金额翻了一倍。
senses.why: Latin ad montem meant up to the mountain, to the measure line; the final total is where the counting stops.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ad montem 意为「到山顶、到刻度处」；计数走到头的那个读数，就是总量。

senses.title: To add up to a total
senses.definition: to reach a particular total when quantities are added together
senses.definitionCN: 各项相加后达到某个总数
senses.example: The bill amounts to three hundred dollars.
senses.exampleCN: 账单合计三百美元。
senses.why: The mountain image of a measure line became the verb: the additions climb until they reach the final figure.
senses.whyCN: 「量到刻度」的画面转为动词：各项累加不断攀升，直至抵达最终数字。

senses.title: To be equal to in effect
senses.definition: to be the same as something else in meaning, effect, or importance
senses.definitionCN: 在含义、效果或重要性上等同于某事物
senses.example: His silence amounts to an apology.
senses.exampleCN: 他的沉默等于道歉。
senses.why: If two things reach the same measure line, they are practically the same; totals become equivalence.
senses.whyCN: 若两样东西到达同一刻度，实质上便是一回事；「总量」由此引申为「等同」。

intro.en: Amount comes from Old French amonter, to rise to, from Latin ad montem, up to the mountain.
intro.cn: amount 来自古法语 amonter「上升到」，可追溯至拉丁语 ad montem「直到山顶」。

items.en: The root *men- meant to project or stand out, seen in Latin mons, mountain.
items.cn: 词根 *men- 表示「突出、隆起」，见于拉丁语 mons「山」。

items.en: The phrase ad montem meant up to the mountain, hence to the required measure.
items.cn: 短语 ad montem 意为「到山（刻度）顶处」，引申为达到所需量。

items.en: Old French amonter meant to rise to, to amount to.
items.cn: 古法语 amonter 意为「上升到；合计达」。

items.en: English adopted amount as a verb in the 13th century, first for rising up.
items.cn: 英语 13 世纪先以动词借入 amount，本义为「升起、登高」。

items.en: The sense climbed from rising to totaling to meaning, and the noun for the final figure became the leading use.
items.cn: 词义从「升高」到「合计」再到「实质等同」层层攀升，名词「总额」成为最常用义。

note.en: Amount is contrasted with number, and its verb sense overlaps with equal and total.
note.cn: amount 与 number 用法相对；其动词义与 equal、total 交错。

entries.definition: to climb; a mountain
entries.definitionCN: 登上；山，与 amount 同出 mons（山）一源

entries.definition: more important than anything else
entries.definitionCN: 至高无上的，同含 mont（山）词根

entries.definition: to overcome a difficulty
entries.definitionCN: 克服（困难），越过山头之意，同根

entries.definition: a report or bank record
entries.definitionCN: 账户；描述，与 amount 拼写结构相近但词根不同（count 计数）

entries.definition: an amount that can be counted or measured
entries.definitionCN: 数量，强调可测度性，与 amount 常可互换

entries.definition: the whole sum
entries.definitionCN: 总数，强调各项相加的结果

entries.definition: the result of adding numbers
entries.definitionCN: 和；金额

entries.definition: used with countable nouns
entries.definitionCN: 与可数名词连用（a number of），与 amount of 用于不可数名词相对

entries.definition: the same as in value or meaning
entries.definitionCN: 相等；等同于，对应动词义项

normalIntro.en: See the mountain inside amount to remember the measure line.
normalIntro.cn: 看见 amount 里的「山」，就想起刻度线。

normal.en: a + mount: a climbing up to the measure line.
normal.cn: a + mount：向上攀到刻度线。

normal.en: Latin mons, montis means mountain.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 mons（词干 mont-）意为山。

normal.en: paramount and surmount keep the mountain visible.
normal.cn: paramount 与 surmount 中山根清晰可见。

normal.en: amount OF for uncountables, number OF for countables.
normal.cn: amount of 接不可数名词，number of 接可数名词。

normal.en: amount to = end up being, as in amount to nothing.
normal.cn: amount to 表示「到头来就是」，如 amount to nothing。

abstract.en: Watch droplets gather in a jar until the scale reads a total.
abstract.cn: 看着水滴汇入量杯，直到刻度读出总量。

abstract.en: See every bill stacking upward until it reaches one number.
abstract.cn: 想象一张张账单向上堆叠，最终归于一个数字。

abstract.en: Feel how silence can carry the same weight as words.
abstract.cn: 感受沉默竟能与言语分量相当。

examples.en: He spends a large amount of time on practice.
examples.cn: 他花大量时间练习。

examples.en: The losses amount to two million dollars.
examples.cn: 亏损总额达两百万美元。

examples.en: Not answering the letter amounts to an insult.
examples.cn: 不回信无异于侮辱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺蚂蚁」——俺家的蚂蚁再多也要数个总量：多少只、多重，就是 amount（数量）。

root: 拉丁语 ad（到）+ mont-（山，词根 *men-「隆起」），ad montem「到山顶处」引申为「达到量度」，经古法语 amonter 进入英语。同根词 mount、paramount、surmount。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the measured total, to the act of adding up, to practical equivalence.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「计量的总量」出发，经「合计的动作」，引申为「实质上的等同」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rising measure line that finally reads the total
core.cn: 核心意象：不断攀升、最终读出总量的刻度线

branches.en: The final figure on the scale
branches.cn: 刻度线上的最终读数，即总额

branches.en: The climb and the number it reaches
branches.cn: 累加的攀升过程与其抵达的数字

branches.en: Adding parts until they total
branches.cn: 把各部分相加直到合计

branches.en: Two things hitting the same line
branches.cn: 两者到达同一刻度即等同

branches.en: Totals that decide what something really is
branches.cn: 合计之数决定事物的实质

intro.en: Amount hides the Latin mountain root mont- behind a French verb shape.
intro.cn: amount 在法语动词外形之下藏着拉丁语「山」词根 mont-。

latinIntro.en: Latin mons, montis and ad- anchor the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mons（词干 mont-）与介词 ad- 是词族的锚点。

latinEntries.meaning: up to the mountain, to the measure

derivatives.zh: 多山的；巨大的（同根派生）

definition_zh: 充足的；宽敞的；丰满的
definition_en: more than enough in size, quantity, or space
core_image: 撑满整个画框的宽大衣袍，处处有余
scene: 法官给双方律师留足申辩时间。The judge allowed ample time for both lawyers to present their arguments.
sceneCN: 这里的 ample 是「充足的」（第 1 个义项：绰绰有余）；句意是法官给双方律师留了充足的时间陈述论点。

collocations.zh: 丰满的身形；宽大的格局

derivatives.zh: 由 ample 词根 ampl- 派生，义为「放大；增强；扩充」
由 amplify 加名词后缀 -er 构成，义为「放大器」
由 ampl- 加后缀 -itude 构成，义为「振幅；广大；充足」
由 amplify 派生，义为「放大；扩充；详述」

senses.title: More than enough in quantity
senses.definition: as much or as many as needed and more; more than sufficient
senses.definitionCN: 足够且有余，超出需要的量
senses.example: There is ample evidence to convict him.
senses.exampleCN: 证据充足，足以给他定罪。
senses.why: The Latin root ampl- means large; what fills beyond the required line is ample.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 ampl- 意为「大」；超出所需刻度、漫出来的量就是充足。

senses.title: Large in size or width
senses.definition: physically large, wide, or capacious
senses.definitionCN: 面积大、空间宽敞，形容房间、衣袍等实物尺寸
senses.example: The library has ample reading rooms with high windows.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆有宽敞的阅览室，窗户高亮。
senses.why: Largeness of quantity extends naturally to largeness of physical extent.
senses.whyCN: 量的「大」自然延伸到形体的「大」：能装得下更多就是宽敞。

senses.title: Full and generous in shape
senses.titleCN: 丰满的；宽松的（体形或衣物）
senses.definition: describing a full figure or loose, generously cut clothing
senses.definitionCN: 形容体形丰腴或衣物剪裁宽大有余
senses.example: She wore an ample robe that swept the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿着一件曳地的宽大衣袍。
senses.why: A body or garment that spills generously beyond the frame shows the same largeness as an ample supply.
senses.whyCN: 体态或衣物丰盈地漫出轮廓，与供应漫出需求是同一种「大」，故引申为丰满、宽松。

intro.en: Ample comes from Latin amplus, large or spacious, of uncertain older origin.
intro.cn: ample 来自拉丁语 amplus「大的、宽敞的」，更早来源不确定。

items.en: Possible links to a root meaning to fill or spread exist, but the chain is uncertain.
items.cn: 或与表示「充满、铺展」的词根有关，但演变链条存疑。

items.en: Latin amplus meant large, spacious, or honorable; amplificare meant to enlarge.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amplus 意为「大的、宽敞的、尊贵的」；amplificare 意为「放大」。

items.en: Old French ample kept the sense of wide and extensive.
items.cn: 古法语 ample 保留「宽阔、广博」之义。

items.en: English adopted ample in the 15th century for generous in size and quantity.
items.cn: 英语于 15 世纪借入 ample，表示尺寸与数量上的宽绰。

items.en: The word now covers sufficiency, spaciousness, and generous body or garment shapes.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖充足、宽敞以及体态衣物之丰盈宽大。

note.en: Ample sits between enough and abundant, and is paired with its noun-family amplify and amplitude.
note.cn: ample 介于 enough 与 abundant 之间，并与同族的 amplify、amplitude 配套。

entries.definition: to make larger or louder
entries.definitionCN: 放大、增强，与 ample 同出拉丁语 amplus

entries.definition: largeness; the height of a wave
entries.definitionCN: 广大；振幅，与 ample 同根的名词

entries.definition: a device that increases volume or signal
entries.definitionCN: 放大器，amplify 的施动者名词

entries.definition: to walk slowly
entries.definitionCN: 缓行，与 ample 只是拼写相近，词源不同（行走 vs 大）

entries.definition: existing in large quantities
entries.definitionCN: 丰富的、大量的，程度比 ample 更强

entries.definition: available in large amounts
entries.definitionCN: 丰富的，侧重供应充足

entries.definition: larger or more than usual
entries.definitionCN: 宽厚的、慷慨的，兼有量足与心善两义

entries.definition: able to hold much
entries.definitionCN: 容量大的，对应宽敞义项

entries.definition: barely enough
entries.definitionCN: barely enough 不足的、仅有的，直接反义

normalIntro.en: The ampl- family makes ample easy to hold in memory.
normalIntro.cn: ampl- 词族让 ample 好记。

normal.en: ampl- is the Latin root of large.
normal.cn: ampl- 是拉丁语「大」的词根。

normal.en: amplify adds -fy, meaning to make large.
normal.cn: amplify 加 -fy，表示「使变大」。

normal.en: amplitude adds -itude, meaning largeness as a measure.
normal.cn: amplitude 加 -itude，表示作为度量的「广度、振幅」。

normal.en: ample food and ample time both mean more than needed.
normal.cn: ample food 与 ample time 都指超出所需。

normal.en: ample is stronger than enough but softer than abundant.
normal.cn: ample 比 enough 强、比 abundant 委婉。

abstract.en: See a robe that billows well past the chair it hangs on.
abstract.cn: 想象一件袍子鼓胀开来，远超所搭的椅子。

abstract.en: Watch a table where every plate is full and no guest reaches twice.
abstract.cn: 想象满桌的餐盘，客人无需二次伸手。

abstract.en: Feel a timeline that stretches far beyond the deadline.
abstract.cn: 感受时间轴远远越过了截止线的从容。

examples.en: You will have ample opportunity to ask questions.
examples.cn: 你将有充足的机会提问。

examples.en: The hotel offers ample parking for guests.
examples.cn: 酒店为客人提供宽敞的停车场。

examples.en: He is a man of ample build and easy manners.
examples.cn: 他体格丰硕，举止从容。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安蒲」——安安稳稳铺开的席面比客人还多，铺得漫出来就是 ample：充足、宽敞。

root: 拉丁语 amplus「大的、宽敞的」，词根 ampl-「大」；词源更早阶段来源不确定。同族词 amplify（放大）、amplitude（振幅）、amplifier（放大器）。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from more-than-enough quantity, through wide physical space, to generous body or garment shapes.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「超过所需的量」出发，经「宽大的物理空间」，延伸到「丰盈的体态与宽绰的衣物」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: largeness that spills past every needed line
core.cn: 核心意象：漫过一切所需刻度的「大」

branches.en: Supply beyond the need line
branches.cn: 越过需求线的供应，即充足

branches.en: Quantity largeness turned into space largeness
branches.cn: 量的大转为空间的大

branches.en: Rooms and halls that hold everything easily
branches.cn: 轻松容纳一切的房间与大厅

branches.en: Forms that spill past their outline
branches.cn: 漫出轮廓的体态与衣袍

branches.en: Generosity felt both in amount and in shape
branches.cn: 在数量与形状上同样可感的宽绰

intro.en: Ample stands on the single Latin root ampl-, large.
intro.cn: ample 建立在拉丁语词根 ampl-「大」之上。

latinIntro.en: Latin amplus heads the ampl- family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 amplus 领衔 ampl- 词族。

derivatives.zh: 放大；增强
振幅；广大

definition_zh: 振幅；广阔；充足
definition_en: the largeness or fullness of something; the height of a wave from its middle line
core_image: 声波从静线荡开的最大摆幅
scene: 技术员调高旋钮，波形在屏上拔高。The engineer turned the dial to increase the amplitude of the signal wave.
sceneCN: 这里的 amplitude 是「振幅」（第 1 个义项：波峰到中线的距离）；句意是工程师转动旋钮增大了信号波的振幅。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「充足的；宽敞的」
由同根 ampl- 派生，义为「放大；增强」
由 amplify 派生，义为「放大；扩充」

senses.title: The height of a wave or vibration
senses.definition: in physics, the maximum distance a wave or vibration moves from its central position
senses.definitionCN: 物理学中波或振动偏离中心位置的最大距离
senses.example: Louder sounds have waves of greater amplitude.
senses.exampleCN: 更响的声音其波的振幅更大。
senses.why: The Latin root ampl- means large; the largeness of a swing from the rest line is exactly amplitude.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 ampl- 意为「大」；摆动偏离静线的幅度之大，正是振幅之义。

senses.title: Largeness or breadth in general
senses.definition: the quality of being large, broad, or extensive, especially of space or range
senses.definitionCN: 空间或范围上的大而广，如视野、疆域的辽阔
senses.example: The amplitude of the savanna stretched to the horizon.
senses.exampleCN: 稀树草原的辽阔一直延伸到地平线。
senses.why: Once the word means measurable largeness, any broad extent can be described by it.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个词表示「可度量的大」，任何广阔的范围便都能用它来描述。

senses.title: Fullness of supply or mind
senses.definition: abundance or richness, as of knowledge, style, or provision
senses.definitionCN: 知识、文风或供应上的丰富充盈
senses.example: He spoke with amplitude, drawing on years of reading.
senses.exampleCN: 他旁征博引，讲得充实丰沛。
senses.why: Largeness applied to knowledge or style becomes richness and fullness of expression.
senses.whyCN: 「大」用在学识或文风上，就成了表达的丰富与充盈。

intro.en: Amplitude comes from Latin amplitudo, largeness, formed on amplus, large.
intro.cn: amplitude 来自拉丁语 amplitudo「广大」，由 amplus「大」加抽象名词后缀 -tudo 构成。

items.en: The older root behind amplus is uncertain; links to filling or spreading have been proposed.
items.cn: amplus 更早的词根存疑，一说与「充满、铺展」相关。

items.en: Latin amplus meant large, and amplitudo meant largeness or magnificence.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amplus 意为「大」，amplitudo 意为「广大、宏伟」。

items.en: French amplitude carried the word into learned usage.
items.cn: 法语 amplitude 使该词进入学术用法。

items.en: English adopted amplitude in the 16th century for greatness of extent.
items.cn: 英语 16 世纪借入 amplitude，表示范围之广大。

items.en: Physics later fixed the word for the peak distance of a wave, now its dominant sense.
items.cn: 物理学随后将这个词固定为波的峰值距离，即今天的主导义项。

note.en: Amplitude belongs to the ampl- family and contrasts with smallness words.
note.cn: amplitude 属于 ampl- 词族，与「小」类词相对。

entries.definition: more than enough
entries.definitionCN: 充足的、宽敞的，与 amplitude 同根的形容词

entries.definition: to make larger or louder
entries.definitionCN: 放大，同根动词

entries.definition: height above sea level

entries.definition: a way of feeling or thinking

entries.definition: great size or importance
entries.definitionCN: 大小；量级，同为 -itude 度量名词

entries.definition: the distance or range of something wide
entries.definitionCN: 宽度；广度

entries.definition: the extent of variation
entries.definitionCN: 范围；幅度

entries.definition: a very large quantity
entries.definitionCN: 丰裕，对应充足义项

entries.definition: smallness of amount or quality
entries.definitionCN: 贫乏、微薄，直接反义

normalIntro.en: Keep the ampl- root and the -itude measure ending in view.

normal.en: ampl- means large; -itude names a measure.

normal.en: amplitude is the measure of largeness.
normal.cn: amplitude 即「大的度量」。

normal.en: compare altitude from alt-, high.
normal.cn: 对比 altitude，出自 alt-「高」。

normal.en: AM radio is amplitude modulation.
normal.cn: AM 广播即「调幅」。

normal.en: the family runs ample, amplify, amplitude.
normal.cn: 词族链为 ample、amplify、amplitude。

abstract.en: See a wave rising tall above its flat middle line.
abstract.cn: 想象一道波从平直中线高高扬起。

abstract.en: Picture a plain so wide that roads seem like threads.
abstract.cn: 想象一片旷野，公路细如丝线。

abstract.en: Feel a lecture brimming with citations and stories.
abstract.cn: 感受一场旁征博引、充实丰沛的讲座。

examples.en: The amplitude of the earthquake wave was extreme.
examples.cn: 这次地震波的振幅极大。

examples.en: She spoke with amplitude about the poet's craft.
examples.cn: 她关于诗人技艺的论述充实丰沛。

examples.en: AM stands for amplitude modulation.
examples.cn: AM 代表调幅。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安普提」——安上「普适」的「提升」旋钮，一提就高：波形抬得越高，振幅越大，就是 amplitude。

root: 拉丁语 amplus「大」+ 抽象名词后缀 -tudo（英语 -itude），amplitudo 即「广度、大小」。同族词 ample、amplify、amplification。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the measured swing of a wave, through broad extent, to fullness of supply or style.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「波动的峰值幅度」出发，经「范围之广」，延伸到「供应或文风的丰盈」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the tallest point a swinging wave reaches
core.cn: 核心意象：摆动的波所抵达的最高点

branches.en: The wave's peak distance measured
branches.cn: 被度量的波峰距离，即振幅

放大；增强

definition_zh: 娱乐；消遣；乐趣
definition_en: the feeling of finding something funny or enjoyable; entertainment
core_image: 旋转木马上扬起的笑声
scene: 孩子们在旋转木马旁笑个不停。To the children's amusement, the pony kept circling the same old track.
sceneCN: 这里的 amusement 是「乐趣」（第 1 个义项：觉得有趣的心情）；句意是让孩子们觉得好笑的是，小马一直在同一条旧轨道上转圈。

derivatives.zh: 由 amusement 还原的动词，义为「逗乐；使愉快」
由 amuse 加 -ing 构成，义为「有趣的、好笑的」

senses.title: The feeling of finding something funny
senses.definition: the state of being entertained or made to smile by something
senses.definitionCN: 被某事物逗乐、感到愉快好笑的心理状态
senses.example: She watched the puppy with quiet amusement.
senses.exampleCN: 她饶有兴味地看着那只小狗。
senses.why: Muser in French means to ponder; being drawn out of one's thoughts into a smile became amusement.
senses.whyCN: 法语 muser 意为「沉思」；被从事事的沉思中「拉扯出来」、嘴角上扬，便成了 amusement。

senses.title: Entertainment provided for pleasure
senses.definition: an activity, place, or thing that entertains people
senses.definitionCN: 供人消遣娱乐的活动、场所或设施，如游乐园、游戏
senses.example: The pier offers arcades, rides, and other amusements.
senses.exampleCN: 码头游乐区提供游戏厅、游乐设施等各种娱乐。
senses.why: A feeling can name the things that produce it; what creates the smile is then itself called amusement.
senses.whyCN: 心理状态可以反过来命名产生它的事物；能带来笑容的东西本身也被称作「娱乐」。

senses.title: Something done to pass time
senses.definition: a light activity that fills idle time, without deep purpose
senses.definitionCN: 打发空闲时间的轻松活动，不含深远目的
senses.example: For her, gardening is not work but amusement.
senses.exampleCN: 对她来说，园艺不是劳作而是消遣。
senses.why: Being drawn away from serious thought also means light, purposeless passing of time.
senses.whyCN: 「从沉思中抽离」同时也意味着轻松无目的地消磨时光，故引申为「消遣」。

intro.en: Amusement traces to French amuser, from a at plus muser to ponder, literally to draw someone out of thought into a smile.
intro.cn: amusement 源自法语 amuser，由 a（朝向）+ muser（沉思）构成，字面为「把人从沉思中引开」。

items.en: The root behind muser is uncertain; some link it to muttering sounds.
items.cn: muser 的更早词根存疑，一说与咕哝声相关，一般作不确定处理。

items.en: Old French muser meant to ponder or stare fixedly, perhaps at a muzzle-like grimace.
items.cn: 古法语 muser 意为「沉思、凝视」，一说与噘嘴沉思的表情有关。

items.en: French amuser meant to divert, to cause to waste time pleasantly.
items.cn: 法语 amuser 意为「使人分心消遣、愉快地打发时间」。

items.en: English amuse first meant to deceive or divert attention, then to entertain.
items.cn: 英语 amuse 最初指「分散注意力、蒙骗」，后转为「逗乐」。

items.en: Amusement now names both the smile itself and the parks, games, and pastimes that produce it.
items.cn: 现代 amusement 既指那份笑意本身，也指产生笑意的游乐园、游戏与消遣。

note.en: Amusement overlaps with entertainment and fun, and should not be confused with muse words.
note.cn: amusement 与 entertainment、fun 意义交错；勿与 muse（沉思）一族混淆。

entries.definition: funny; entertaining

normal.en: a- + muse + -ment: pulled away from pondering.
normal.cn: a- + muse + -ment：从沉思中被拉开。

normal.en: muse alone still means to think deeply.
normal.cn: muse 单独仍指「深思」。

normal.en: amuse is the verb; amused and amusing are its two faces.
normal.cn: amuse 是动词；amused 与 amusing 是它的两面（被逗乐的/好笑的）。

normal.en: amusement park is the set phrase to remember.
normal.cn: amusement park（游乐园）是要记住的固定搭配。

normal.en: to one's amusement introduces something funny that happens.
normal.cn: to one's amusement 引出令人发笑的情节。

abstract.en: See a frowning thinker suddenly laughing at a circus act.
abstract.cn: 想象一位皱眉的思考者突然被马戏逗笑。

abstract.en: Picture colored rides spinning against the evening sky.
abstract.cn: 想象彩色的游乐设施在夜幕下旋转。

abstract.en: Feel idle hours softly spent with a puzzle book.
abstract.cn: 感受手捧谜题书轻松消磨的午后时光。

examples.en: The comedy offered two hours of pure amusement.
examples.cn: 这部喜剧带来了两个小时的纯粹娱乐。

examples.en: I read detective novels as a light amusement.
examples.cn: 我把读侦探小说当作轻松的消遣。

examples.en: Much to our amusement, the parrot mimicked the teacher.
examples.cn: 令我们大笑的是，鹦鹉学起了老师的腔调。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「啊缪子」——啊，缪斯（灵感女神）都笑场了：连沉思的女神都被逗乐，这就是 amusement（娱乐、乐趣）。

root: 法语 a-（朝向）+ muser（沉思，词根 muse）+ -ment（名词后缀），amuser 字面为「把人从沉思中引开」。同族词 amuse、amusing、muse。

sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「发笑的心情」出发，经「带来笑意的娱乐设施活动」，延伸到「打发时间的消遣」。

branches.cn: 作为心理状态的笑意

definition_zh: 时代错误；过时的人或事物
definition_en: something placed in the wrong historical time, such as an old object in a new age
core_image: 古装剧里惊现的手机
scene: 古罗马影片的近景里露出一块电子表。The digital watch in the crowd scene was an anachronism that viewers quickly spotted.
sceneCN: 这里的 anachronism 是「时代错误」（第 1 个义项：不合时宜地出现）；句意是群众场面中出现的电子表是个观众一眼识破的时代错误。

collocations.phrase: an anachronism in a period drama

derivatives.zh: 由 anachronism 加后缀 -ic 构成，义为「时代错误的、过时的」
由 anachronistic 加 -ly 构成，义为「时代错乱地」

senses.title: A thing out of its proper time
senses.titleCN: 时代错误；不合年代的物件
senses.definition: an object, custom, or detail that belongs to a period other than the one in which it appears
senses.definitionCN: 出现在不属于它的年代里的物件、习俗或细节
senses.example: A clock tower in the ancient village scene was an obvious anachronism.
senses.exampleCN: 古村场景里的钟楼是个明显的时代错误。
senses.why: Chronos means time and ana- means backward; something set against time's current stands out as wrong-timed.
senses.whyCN: chronos 意为「时间」，ana- 表示「逆着」；逆时间之流而置的东西，便是刺眼的时间错位。

senses.title: A person or idea that belongs to an earlier age
senses.definition: a person, institution, or custom that survives from an earlier period and now seems outdated
senses.definitionCN: 从早期年代留存至今、显得不合时宜的人、制度或习俗
senses.example: In the age of instant messaging, the telegram office is an anachronism.
senses.exampleCN: 在即时通讯时代，电报局已成过时之物。
senses.why: If a detail can be out of time inside a story, a whole institution can be out of time inside history.
senses.whyCN: 既然细节可以在故事中错时，整个制度也可以在历史中错时——存留至今的旧物即成了时代错误。

intro.en: Anachronism comes from Greek anachronismos, built on ana backward and chronos time.
intro.cn: anachronism 源自希腊语 anachronismos，由 ana（逆、向后）+ chronos（时间）构成。

items.en: The root *gher- behind chronos related to time or seasons; the detail is reconstructed.
items.cn: chronos 背后的词根 *gher- 与时间、季节相关，细节属重构形式。

items.en: Greek chronos meant time, and anachronismos meant an error in reckoning time.
items.cn: 希腊语 chronos 意为「时间」，anachronismos 意为「计时上的错误」。

items.en: Scholars kept the Greek compound in learned Latin writing.
items.cn: 学者们在学术拉丁文中保留了这一希腊复合词。

items.en: English adopted anachronism in the 17th century for errors in dating events.
items.cn: 英语 17 世纪借入 anachronism，最初指纪年上的错误。

items.en: The word now labels both factual slips in period settings and anything charmingly out of date.
items.cn: 现代用法既指年代剧中的史实穿帮，也指任何带着旧时代气息的落伍之物。

note.en: Anachronism belongs to the chron- time family alongside synchronize and chronology.
note.cn: anachronism 属 chron-（时间）词族，与 synchronize、chronology 同门。

normal.en: anachronism = set against the right time.
normal.cn: anachronism = 与正确时间相逆。

normal.en: synchronize joins times; anachronism breaks time.

normal.en: the adjective is anachronistic, with -ic.
normal.cn: 形容词为 anachronistic，加 -ic。

abstract.en: See a wristwatch glowing on a knight's arm in a museum painting.
abstract.cn: 想象博物馆油画里骑士腕上闪光的电子表。

abstract.en: Picture a telegraph key sitting on a modern office desk.
abstract.cn: 想象现代办公桌上摆着一部电报键。

abstract.en: Feel time flowing one way while one object stands facing upstream.
abstract.cn: 感受时间单向奔流，而某物偏偏逆流而立。

examples.en: The film was praised until viewers found a cigarette lighter in a Viking camp.
examples.cn: 影片本备受赞誉，直到观众发现维京营地中出现了打火机。

examples.en: Rigid formality now seems an anachronism in business.
examples.cn: 刻板的繁文缛节在商界如今显得不合时宜。

examples.en: Criticizing the play for anachronism misses its point.
examples.cn: 以时代错误为由批评这部剧，其实没看懂它的用意。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「啊那壳 hard」——啊，那个壳（怀表壳）怎会出现在原始人手里？时间错位的物件就是 anachronism。

senses.title: Wrong for the period depicted

senses.title: Out of step with the present age

senses.exampleCN: 在数字化办公室里，手写账簿显得很不合时宜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺那壳润死体温」——俺那块壳（怀表）把时间润死了：表停在过去，时间错位，就是 anachronistic。

root: 希腊语 ana-（逆、向后）+ chronos（时间）+ -istic（形容词后缀）。由名词 anachronism（时代错误）派生。同族词 chronology、synchronize、chronic。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from mistimed details inside artworks to whole habits left behind by the present.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「作品内部错置时代的细节」出发，扩展到「被当下甩落的整体习俗与观念」。

branches.cn: 暴露年代的道具细节

branches.en: From inside the frame to outside it
branches.cn: 从画框内的错时到画框外的落伍

branches.en: Habits wearing the dust of a past age
branches.cn: 蒙着旧时代灰尘的习惯

branches.en: Wrong time read as fault or as flavor
branches.cn: 错时既可视为毛病，也可视为风味

branches.en: People set deliberately out of season
branches.cn: 被刻意「放错季节」的人与物

definition_zh: 类比；类推；比喻
definition_en: a comparison between two things that shows how they are similar in some way
core_image: 用熟悉的地图解释陌生的城市
scene: 老师用电厂水流解释电流的原理。The teacher drew an analogy between flowing water and electric current.
sceneCN: 这里的 analogy 是「类比」（第 1 个义项：两物的相似性比较）；句意是老师在流水与电流之间作类比讲解。

collocations.phrase: the argument rests on an analogy

derivatives.zh: 由 analogy 的词根 analog- 派生，义为「类似的、可类比的」
同根词，义为「模拟的（连续信号）」，与数字 digital 相对
由 analog- 加 -ize 构成，义为「作类比推理」
同根名词，义为「相似物；对应物」

senses.title: A comparison of similarities
senses.definition: a comparison made to explain one thing by pointing out how it resembles another, usually a familiar one
senses.definitionCN: 借助两物的相似性，尤其用熟悉的事物来解释陌生的事物
senses.example: She used an analogy of a bathtub to explain supply and demand.
senses.exampleCN: 她用浴缸作类比来解释供需关系。
senses.why: Ana- means according to and logos means ratio or reckoning; an analogy lays things side by side in the same ratio.
senses.whyCN: ana- 表示「按照」，logos 表示「比例、推理」；类比就是按同一比例把两物并排摆好。

senses.title: Reasoning from parallel cases
senses.definition: a form of reasoning that concludes something about one case because it resembles another case
senses.definitionCN: 因两案相似而由一案推及另一案的推理方式
senses.example: By analogy with earlier rulings, the court allowed the appeal.
senses.exampleCN: 参照先例类推，法院受理了上诉。
senses.why: The same ratio that explains can also argue: if two things match in known parts, they may match in the unknown part.
senses.whyCN: 同一比例既能解释也能论证：已知部分相合，未知部分也可推定相合。

senses.title: Partial likeness between things
senses.definition: an actual point of resemblance between two things, not just the act of comparing
senses.definitionCN: 两物之间实际存在的相似点，而非比较这一行为
senses.example: There is a close analogy between bird wings and whale flippers.
senses.exampleCN: 鸟翼与鲸鳍之间存在明显的同源相似。
senses.why: Once comparison is possible, the similarity it reveals can be named by the same word.
senses.whyCN: 既然可以比较，比较所揭示的相似本身也用这个词来命名。

intro.en: Analogy comes from Greek analogia, proportion, from ana according to plus logos ratio.
intro.cn: analogy 源自希腊语 analogia「比例」，由 ana（按照）+ logos（比例、推理）构成。

items.en: The root *leg- behind logos meant to gather or to pick out words.
items.cn: logos 背后的词根 *leg- 表示「收集、选取词语」。

items.en: Greek analogia meant proportion, as in the equality of ratios in mathematics.
items.cn: 希腊语 analogia 意为「比例」，用于数学中比率相等之义。

items.en: Latin analogia kept the mathematical and rhetorical senses.
items.cn: 拉丁语 analogia 保留了数学与修辞两方面的意义。

items.en: French analogie passed the word into scholarly usage.
items.cn: 法语 analogie 使该词进入学术用语。

items.en: English adopted analogy in the 16th century for proportion, then for likeness and reasoning from likeness.
items.cn: 英语 16 世纪借入 analogy，先指比例，后指相似性与由相似而作的推理。

note.en: Analogy belongs to the log- word family and is contrasted with metaphor and literal statement.
note.cn: analogy 属 log- 词族，与 metaphor 及直陈说法相对。

entries.definition: similar in a way that allows comparison
entries.definitionCN: 类似的、可类比的，analogy 的形容词

entries.definition: a thing corresponding to another
entries.definitionCN: 对应物；模拟的，同根名词与形容词

entries.definition: an expression of regret
entries.definitionCN: 道歉，与 analogy 拼写相近但词根不同（apo- 离开）

entries.definition: the study of living things
entries.definitionCN: 生物学，同用 -logy（学、论说）词尾

entries.definition: the act of examining similarities and differences
entries.definitionCN: 比较，比 analogy 更中性、更全面

entries.definition: a figure of speech naming one thing as another
entries.definitionCN: 隐喻，直接把甲说成乙，而 analogy 是摆出相似关系

entries.definition: a close similarity between two things
entries.definitionCN: 相似之处、平行例证

entries.definition: a match between things
entries.definitionCN: 对应关系

entries.definition: plain direct wording without comparison
entries.definitionCN: 直陈表述，与类比修辞相对

normalIntro.en: Hold ana- plus logos, ratio, to fix analogy in memory.
normalIntro.cn: 抓住 ana- 加 logos（比例）来记 analogy。

normal.en: ana- means according to; logos means ratio or word.
normal.cn: ana- 表示「按照」；logos 表示「比例、言语」。

normal.en: the plural changes y to ies: analogies.
normal.cn: 复数把 y 变 ies：analogies。

normal.en: draw an analogy between is the key phrase.
normal.cn: 关键搭配是 draw an analogy between。

normal.en: analogous is the adjective partner.
normal.cn: 形容词搭档是 analogous。

normal.en: analogy argues, metaphor paints.
normal.cn: 类比用来论证，隐喻用来描绘。

abstract.en: See a teacher holding a map beside an unfamiliar city plan.
abstract.cn: 想象老师把熟悉的城市地图摆在陌生蓝图旁对照。

abstract.en: Picture two unequal beams balanced by a moving weight.
abstract.cn: 想象两根不等长杠杆被砝码调平，比例即类比的骨架。

abstract.en: Feel two unfamiliar roads easing your path once they echo one another.
abstract.cn: 感受两条相似道路彼此呼应、让路途变熟。

examples.en: He drew an analogy between the immune system and an army.
examples.cn: 他把免疫系统类比为一支军队。

examples.en: By analogy, the same rule should govern both cases.
examples.cn: 依此类推，同一规则应适用于两案。

examples.en: The analogy is helpful, though not exact.
examples.cn: 这个类比虽有助理解，但并不完全贴切。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺那老记」——俺那老记性不好，就用熟悉的例子打比方：一比就懂，这就是 analogy（类比）。

root: 希腊语 ana-（按照、相对）+ logos（比例；言语）+ -ia（名词后缀），analogia 本义「成比例」。同族词 analogous、analogue、analogize。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the explanatory comparison, through reasoning by parallel cases, to the likeness itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「解释性的比较」出发，经「依据相似案例的类推」，最终落在「相似性本身」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the known laid beside the unknown in the same ratio
core.cn: 核心意象：把已知与未知按同一比例并排放置

branches.en: Explaining the strange through the familiar
branches.cn: 以熟释生，即类比说明

branches.en: The same likeness used to argue
branches.cn: 同一相似性转作论证之用

branches.en: Reasoning across parallel cases
branches.cn: 在平行案例间推理，即类推

branches.en: The conclusion resting on the resemblance found
branches.cn: 结论立足于所找到的相似点

branches.en: Resemblance as a fact of structure
branches.cn: 相似性作为结构事实，如鸟翼与鲸鳍

intro.en: Analogy builds on ana- and the great root logos.
intro.cn: analogy 建立在 ana- 与大词根 logos 之上。

latinIntro.en: The log- family is Greek rather than Latin in origin.
latinIntro.cn: log- 词族源自希腊语而非拉丁语。

definition_zh: 分析；分解；解析
definition_en: the process of separating something into its parts to understand it better
core_image: 把机器零件一件件摊开在桌布上
scene: 她把季度报表逐项摊开来查亏损的来源。Her careful analysis of the quarterly report revealed where the losses began.
sceneCN: 这里的 analysis 是「分析」（第 1 个义项：拆分以查明原因）；句意是她对季报的细致分析找出了亏损的起点。

derivatives.zh: 由词根 ana- + ly- 派生的动词，义为「分析；分解」
由 analyze 派生的施动者名词，义为「分析员；化验员」
同根形容词，义为「分析的；善于分析的」
analytic 的变体形式，义为「分析性的」

senses.title: Separating a whole into parts to understand it
senses.definition: the act of studying something by separating it into its parts and examining their relations
senses.definitionCN: 把整体拆分成组成部分并考察其相互关系以便理解的研究方法
senses.example: The chemist began her analysis of the unknown powder.
senses.exampleCN: 化学家开始对未知粉末进行分析。
senses.why: Ana- means up throughout and lyein means to loosen; the picture is unbinding a knot piece by piece.
senses.whyCN: ana- 表示「彻底、从头到尾」，lyein 表示「松开」；画面就是把绳结一段段解开。

senses.title: A statement of the results of such study
senses.definition: a report or document presenting the findings of an examination
senses.definitionCN: 呈现研究结果或结论的报告、文件
senses.example: Her analysis was published in the economics journal.
senses.exampleCN: 她的分析发表在了经济学期刊上。
senses.why: The act of unloosing produces findings; the findings then inherit the name of the act.
senses.whyCN: 「拆解」这一行为产出结论，结论便继承了行为的名称。

senses.title: Psychoanalytic examination of the mind
senses.definition: the treatment or study of a mind by exploring its hidden motives and memories
senses.definitionCN: 通过探索潜在动机与记忆来研究或治疗心理的方法，如精神分析
senses.example: He spent years in psychoanalysis after the war.
senses.exampleCN: 战后他接受了多年的精神分析治疗。
senses.why: The mind, too, is unbound layer by layer, each loosened layer revealing another.
senses.whyCN: 心灵同样被逐层「松绑」，松开一层便显露下一层，故借用此词。

intro.en: Analysis comes from Greek analusis, a loosening up, from ana up plus lyein to loosen.
intro.cn: analysis 源自希腊语 analusis「解开、松开」，由 ana（彻底）+ lyein（松开）构成。

items.en: The root *leu- meant to loosen, divide, or cut apart.
items.cn: 词根 *leu- 表示「松开、分开、切离」。

items.en: Greek analusis meant a releasing or resolving, first of problems into simpler steps.
items.cn: 希腊语 analusis 意为「释放、化解」，最早指把难题化解为简单步骤。

items.en: Greek geometers used analysis for working backward from a result to its principles.
items.cn: 希腊几何学家用 analysis 表示从结论反推前提的方法。

items.en: English adopted analysis in the 16th century as a learned term of mathematics and logic.
items.cn: 英语 16 世纪借入 analysis，作为数学与逻辑的学术用语。

items.en: The word now spans laboratory testing, data work, criticism, and psychoanalysis.
items.cn: 如今该词涵盖化验、数据分析、文学批评与精神分析等领域。

note.en: Analysis pairs with its verb analyze and stands opposite synthesis.
note.cn: analysis 与动词 analyze 配套，与 synthesis 相对。

entries.definitionCN: 分析、分解，analysis 的动词

entries.definitionCN: 分析员，加施动者后缀 -ist

entries.definitionCN: 催化作用，同根词 cata-（向下）+ ly-（松开）

entries.definitionCN: 分项明细

entries.definition: combining parts into a whole
entries.definitionCN: 综合、合成，直接反义

normal.cn: paralysis 同根：被彻底解开以致无力。

normal.en: in the final analysis means when everything is weighed.
normal.cn: in the final analysis 意为「归根结底」。

abstract.en: See a knotted rope unbound strand by strand on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上的绳结被一根根解开。

abstract.en: Picture a watch opened on white cloth, gears laid in order.
abstract.cn: 想象白布上打开的怀表，齿轮按序排列。

abstract.en: Feel a question getting lighter as it is divided into small ones.
abstract.cn: 感受问题被拆成小问题后逐一变轻。

examples.en: The analysis of the samples took two weeks.
examples.cn: 样本分析用了两周时间。

examples.en: In the final analysis, effort decides the result.
examples.cn: 归根结底，努力决定结果。

examples.en: Each analysis confirmed the same pattern.
examples.cn: 每一份分析都印证了同一模式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺那坏了」——俺那（机器）坏了，得拆开来看：一件件摊开检查就是 analysis（分析）。

root: 希腊语 ana-（彻底、向上）+ ly-（松开，lyein）+ -sis（名词后缀），analusis 本义「彻底松开」。同族词 analyze、analytic、paralysis、catalysis。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the act of unbinding a whole, to the report of findings, to the loosening of the mind itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「拆解整体的动作」出发，经「呈现结果的报告」，延伸到「对心灵的层层松解」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a knot loosened strand by strand
core.cn: 核心意象：绳结被一根根解开

branches.en: Taking the whole apart to see it
branches.cn: 把整体拆开来看清，即分析

branches.en: The act passing its name to its results

branches.cn: 报告中呈现的分析结论

branches.en: Loosening that ends in understanding
branches.cn: 以领悟为终点的「松开」

definition_zh: 分析员；分析师；化验员
definition_en: a person who examines something in detail to explain or understand it
core_image: 紧盯数据图表逐行批注的人
scene: 发布会上分析师被追问股价走势。The financial analyst explained why the stock kept sliding.
sceneCN: 这里的 analyst 是「分析师」（第 1 个义项：专业分析者）；句意是这位金融分析师解释了股价持续下滑的原因。

senses.title: A professional examiner of data or affairs
senses.definition: a person whose job is to examine data, markets, or events and explain their meaning
senses.definitionCN: 以研究数据、市场或时事并解释其含义为职业的人
senses.example: Analysts expect slower growth next year.
senses.exampleCN: 分析人士预计明年增长放缓。
senses.why: The -ist ending names the doer of analysis; whoever lives by unbinding complexity becomes an analyst.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ist 标记「从事分析的人」；以拆解复杂事物为业者即 analyst。

senses.title: A practitioner of psychoanalysis
senses.definition: a therapist who treats patients through psychoanalysis
senses.definitionCN: 以精神分析方法为患者做治疗的医师
senses.example: She sees her analyst twice a week.
senses.exampleCN: 她每周见两次精神分析医师。
senses.why: Because the method is analysis of the mind, its practitioner keeps the same name.
senses.whyCN: 既然方法是对心灵的「分析」，其从业者便沿用同一名称。

senses.title: A laboratory examiner of substances
senses.definition: a technician who tests substances in a laboratory, such as a chemical analyst
senses.definitionCN: 在实验室里检验物质成分的技术人员，如化学化验员
senses.example: The chemical analyst tested the water for lead.
senses.exampleCN: 化学化验员检测了水中的铅含量。
senses.why: The oldest sense of analysis is laboratory unbinding of matter; the doer of that work keeps the title.
senses.whyCN: analysis 最古老的义项便是在实验室里「拆解」物质；从事这项工作的人保留该头衔。

abstract.cn: 想象灯光柔和的诊室里的长沙发与记事本。

abstract.en: Feel vials and test tubes turning a question into a number.
abstract.cn: 感受试管把疑问化为一个确定的数字。

examples.cn: 该分析师下调了这家公司的股票评级。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺那李斯特」——俺那李斯特不弹琴，专职看数据拆问题：分析的门徒就是 analyst（分析员）。

root: analysis（分析，源于希腊语 ana-「彻底」+ ly-「松开」）+ -ist（从事者后缀）。同族词 analysis、analyze、analytic。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the professional interpreter of data, through the psychoanalytic therapist, to the laboratory examiner.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「数据与时事的专业解读者」出发，经「精神分析治疗师」，延伸到「实验室化验员」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the person hired to unbind complexity
core.cn: 核心意象：受雇拆解复杂事物的人

branches.en: Reading markets and events for meaning
branches.cn: 解读市场与事件之意涵

branches.en: From public data to the private mind
branches.cn: 从公共数据深入到私人心灵

branches.cn: 诊室躺椅也是一张「分析台」

branches.en: Treating minds and testing matter share one method
branches.cn: 疗心与验物同属「松解」之法

branches.en: Vials and titrations in the oldest sense
branches.cn: 试管与滴定，最古老的 analyst 职守

intro.cn: analyst 在 analysis 词族上加施动者后缀 -ist。

latinIntro.en: The Greek ly- root still works underneath.
latinIntro.cn: 底层的希腊语 ly- 词根仍在起作用。
