definition_zh: 分析；分解；解析；精神分析
definition_en: to separate something into its parts in order to understand it
core_image: 把一整块东西沿纹路拆开，逐层看清内部
scene: 实验室里，研究员把水样拆开来一一检测。In the lab, the researcher analyzed the water sample and listed every metal in the report.
sceneCN: 这里 analyze 是「化验分析、分解检测」（第 2 个义项：化学分析，确定成分）；句意：实验室里，研究员分析了水样，并在报告里列出了每一种金属。场景要点：水样、实验台、检测报告、金属成分。

derivatives.zh: 分析；解析
分析师；分析者
分析的；善于分析的
可分析的

senses.title: Break a whole into parts
senses.titleCN: 把整体拆成部分来研究
senses.definition: to separate a complex whole into its parts and study how they relate
senses.definitionCN: 把复杂整体拆成若干部分，并研究它们之间的关系
senses.example: The report analyzes the market into five customer groups.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告把市场拆成五个客户群来分析。
senses.why: Greek analysis meant 'a loosening, a releasing'. To analyze is to loosen a whole until its parts can be seen separately.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 analysis 意为“松开、释放”。analyze 就是把一个整体松开，直到各部分能被单独看见。

senses.title: Chemical analysis: find the ingredients
senses.definition: to determine the chemical composition of a substance
senses.definitionCN: 测定一种物质的化学成分
senses.example: The lab analyzed the soil for lead and mercury.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室分析了土壤中的铅和汞。
senses.why: A substance is a whole made of hidden parts. The oldest scientific sense of analyze is exactly this: loosen the mixture and name what comes out.
senses.whyCN: 一种物质是由看不见的成分构成的整体。analyze 最早的科学义正是如此：把混合物拆开，说出里面有什么。

senses.title: Grammar: parse a sentence
senses.titleCN: 语法分析：切分句子成分
senses.definition: to identify the grammatical parts and relations of a sentence
senses.definitionCN: 识别句子的语法成分及其关系
senses.example: Students analyzed the sentence into subject, verb, and object.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们把这个句子分析成主语、动词和宾语。
senses.why: A sentence is a whole with a structure. Parsing is the grammar version of loosening: words are sorted into their jobs.
senses.whyCN: 句子是有结构的整体。语法分析就是“松开”的语法版本：把词按各自的功能分拣出来。

senses.title: Data analysis: turn numbers into meaning
senses.titleCN: 数据分析：从数字里读出意义
senses.definition: to examine data with statistical or logical methods in order to find patterns
senses.definitionCN: 用统计或逻辑方法检查数据，以发现规律
senses.example: We analyzed three years of sales to find the seasonal pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 我们分析了三年的销售数据，找出季节性规律。
senses.why: A dataset is a heap of records. Analysis sorts the heap into variables, trends and causes, so the parts become visible.
senses.whyCN: 数据集是一堆记录。分析把这一堆分拣成变量、趋势和原因，让各组成部分显现出来。

senses.title: Psychoanalysis: listen to the mind
senses.titleCN: 精神分析：拆解心理活动
senses.definition: to treat a person by examining unconscious feelings and memories
senses.definitionCN: 通过检查潜意识的情感与记忆来治疗一个人
senses.example: The therapist analyzed the patient's dreams for hidden fears.
senses.exampleCN: 治疗师分析病人的梦，寻找隐藏的恐惧。
senses.why: The mind is treated as a whole with hidden layers. Psychoanalysis loosens those layers and looks at what has been pushed apart.
senses.whyCN: 心灵被看成一个有隐藏层次的整体。精神分析把这些层次松开，查看被压到一边的东西。

senses.title: Examine motives and causes
senses.definition: to examine the reasons behind an action or situation in detail
senses.definitionCN: 详细检查一个行为或局面背后的原因
senses.example: The historian analyzed why the reform failed so quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家分析了这场改革为何失败得这么快。
senses.why: Causes are internal parts of an event. To analyze a failure is to open it up and separate its contributing forces.
senses.whyCN: 原因是事件内部的组成部分。分析一次失败，就是把它打开，把起作用的各种力量分开。

senses.title: Analyze a text or a work of art
senses.definition: to study the structure, language, and meaning of a text or artwork
senses.definitionCN: 研究文本或作品的结构、语言与意义
senses.example: The class analyzed the opening scene of the film.
senses.exampleCN: 课堂上分析了这部电影的开场场景。
senses.why: A text is a designed whole. Analysis separates image, rhythm, argument and allusion so that the design can be explained.
senses.whyCN: 文本是被设计出来的整体。分析把意象、节奏、论证和典故分开，设计才解释得清。

senses.title: Analyze a musical structure
senses.definition: to break a piece of music into its themes, harmonies, and formal sections
senses.definitionCN: 把一首乐曲拆成主题、和声与结构段落
senses.example: The conductor analyzed the symphony before rehearsing it.
senses.exampleCN: 指挥在排练前先分析了这部交响曲。
senses.why: Music is a whole that unfolds in time. Analyzing it means separating themes and sections so the listener can hear the architecture.
senses.whyCN: 音乐是在时间中展开的整体。分析音乐就是分出主题与段落，让听者听见它的建筑结构。

intro.en: Analyze is a back-formation: the noun analysis entered English first, and the verb was formed from it. The ultimate source is Greek, not Latin.
intro.cn: analyze 是逆构词：名词 analysis 先进入英语，动词再由它造出。最终来源是希腊语，不是拉丁语。

items.en: The noun analysis is first recorded in the 1580s, meaning 'a resolving of anything complex into its elements'. It came through Medieval Latin from Greek.
items.cn: 名词 analysis 最早记录于 1580 年代，意为“把复杂事物分解为要素”。它经中世纪拉丁语来自希腊语。

items.en: The verb analyze appears around 1600. Etymonline cites Weekley's view that it was formed from the noun rather than borrowed ready-made from French analyser.
items.cn: 动词 analyze 约在 1600 年出现。Etymonline 引用 Weekley 的观点：它是由名词逆构而来，而不是直接从法语 analyser 借来。

items.en: Greek analysis meant 'a dissolving, a loosening', from ana- 'up, throughout, back' + lysis 'a loosening'. The image is a knot being untied.
items.cn: 希腊语 analysis 意为“分解、松开”，来自 ana-“向上、贯穿、返回”+ lysis“松开”。画面是一个结被解开。

items.en: lysis came from lyein 'to loosen, untie, release'. The same verb underlies dialysis and paralysis, where something is loosened apart or beside.
items.cn: lysis 来自 lyein“松开、解开、释放”。同一个动词也构成 dialysis 和 paralysis，表示“分开松开”或“旁边松开”。

items.en: The deeper root is reconstructed as PIE *leu- 'to loosen, divide'. It is a reconstructed form, not a recorded word, so the deepest layer is stated as generally accepted rather than certain.
items.cn: 更深一层被重构为原始印欧语 *leu-“松开、分开”。这是重构形式，不是有记录的词，因此最深层只能说“一般认为是”。

items.en: Modern English uses analyze across chemistry, grammar, statistics, psychology and music. The spelling analyze is standard in American English; British English prefers analyse.
items.cn: 现代英语把 analyze 用在化学、语法、统计、心理和音乐上。美式拼写是 analyze，英式更常用 analyse。

note.en: The first group is about spelling and word class; the second group separates analysis from simpler acts like looking or judging.
note.cn: 第一组看拼写与词性，第二组把“分析”和更简单的“看、判断”分开。

entries.definition: the British spelling of the same verb. The pronunciation is identical; only the ending differs.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个动词的英式拼写。读音完全相同，只是词尾不同。

entries.definition: the noun: the process or result of analyzing. It ends in -sis, while the verb ends in -ze.
entries.definitionCN: 名词：分析的过程或结果。它以 -sis 结尾，而动词以 -ze 结尾。

entries.definition: a person who analyzes data or situations. The -ist suffix marks the person, not the action.
entries.definitionCN: 分析数据或形势的人。-ist 后缀标记人，而不是动作。

entries.definition: to look at something carefully. Examining can be visual; analyzing always involves separating parts or causes.
entries.definitionCN: 仔细查看。examine 可以是视觉上的；analyze 一定涉及拆分部分或原因。

entries.definition: to cut a body or issue into parts for study. It is more physical and narrower than analyze.
entries.definitionCN: 把身体或问题切开研究。它更偏物理、范围更窄。

entries.definition: to judge the value or quality of something. Evaluation follows analysis; it adds a verdict.
entries.definitionCN: 判断某物的价值或质量。评价在分析之后发生，会给出结论。

entries.definition: to explain what something means. Interpretation goes beyond breaking down: it builds a reading.
entries.definitionCN: 解释某物意味着什么。解释不止于拆解，还要建立一套读法。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: ana- + lysis 'a loosening', plus the analysis, analyst and analytical family.
normalIntro.cn: 真实成分与同族词：ana- + lysis“松开”，以及 analysis、analyst、analytical 词族。

normal.en: lysis means 'a loosening'. Analyze is to loosen a whole until the parts separate.
normal.cn: lysis 意为“松开”。analyze 就是把整体松开，直到各部分分开。

normal.en: The noun analysis came first; the verb analyze was cut back from it, like a branch from a tree.
normal.cn: 名词 analysis 先出现；动词 analyze 是从它身上“削”出来的，像从树上截下一根枝条。

normal.en: An analyst is the person; analysis is the thing; analytical is the style.
normal.cn: analyst 是人，analysis 是事，analytical 是风格。

normal.en: Dialysis and paralysis share the same lysis ending: loosening apart, or loosening beside.
normal.cn: dialysis 和 paralysis 共享同一个 lysis 结尾：分开松开，或在旁边松开。

normal.en: In British English the verb is analyse, but the noun is still analysis in both varieties.
normal.cn: 英式英语动词写作 analyse，但名词在两种英语里都还是 analysis。

abstract.en: Think of a clock opened on a table: gears, springs and hands laid out separately. Analyze is the act of opening; analysis is the layout on the table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟被拆开摊在桌上：齿轮、发条、指针各自分开。analyze 是拆开的动作，analysis 是桌上的布局。

abstract.en: The same loosening works on sentences, data, dreams and symphonies. The material changes; the gesture does not.
abstract.cn: 同样的松解作用于句子、数据、梦境和交响曲。材料在变，动作不变。

abstract.en: Analysis is not destruction. The point of loosening is to see relations that were hidden while the whole stayed closed.
abstract.cn: 分析不是破坏。松开的目的是看见整体闭合时被遮住的关系。

examples.en: We need to analyze the survey results before making a decision.
examples.cn: 在做决定之前，我们需要分析调查结果。

examples.en: The teacher analyzed the sentence word by word.
examples.cn: 老师逐词分析了这个句子。

examples.en: Scientists analyzed the ice core to reconstruct the ancient climate.
examples.cn: 科学家分析冰芯，以重建古代气候。

dict_mnemonic.text: “安娜来撕”——安娜把整张纸来撕开，一层层看清里面写了什么 → analyze 分析

root: 源自希腊语 analysis“分解、松开”，由 ana-“贯穿、返回”+ lysis“松开”构成，核心是“把整体解开看清”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of analyze: the same loosening gesture applied to a substance, a sentence, a dataset, a mind, a cause, a text or a piece of music.
sensesIntro.cn: analyze 的八个义项：同一个“松开”动作，作用在物质、句子、数据集、心灵、原因、文本或音乐上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a closed whole is loosened, and its inner parts become visible.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个闭合的整体被松开，内部各部分组成可见。

branches.en: GENERAL BREAKDOWN: a complex whole or a cause is opened into contributing parts.
branches.cn: 一般拆解：复杂整体或原因被打开成若干起作用的部分。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND MUSICAL COMPOSITION: chemical ingredients and musical sections are both 'parts' of a whole.
branches.cn: 物质与音乐构成：化学成分与音乐段落都是整体的“部分”。

branches.en: STRUCTURED TEXTS: sentences and artworks have designed parts that can be separated and related.
branches.cn: 结构化文本：句子与作品都有被设计的部分，可以分开并找出关系。

branches.en: DATA: records are sorted into variables, trends and patterns.
branches.cn: 数据：记录被分拣成变量、趋势与规律。

branches.en: THE MIND: hidden layers of feeling and memory are loosened and examined.
branches.cn: 心灵：情感与记忆的隐藏层次被松开、检查。

intro.en: Analyze is a Greek-derived verb. English adds -s, -ed, -ing and then builds a large family with -sis, -ist, -ical and -able.
intro.cn: analyze 是希腊来源的动词。英语加 -s、-ed、-ing，再用 -sis、-ist、-ical、-able 建起一个很大的词族。

latinIntro.en: There is no native Latin verb family here. The word reached English through Medieval Latin analysis, but the root is Greek lyein 'to loosen', so the Latin entries are left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有本土拉丁动词词族。这个词经中世纪拉丁语 analysis 进入英语，但词根是希腊语 lyein“松开”，因此拉丁条目留空。

items.meaningCN: 他/她/它分析（第三人称单数）
items.example: She analyzes every contract before signing.
items.exampleCN: 她签署前会分析每一份合同。

items.meaning: analyzed in the past, or used as a passive participle
items.meaningCN: 已分析；被分析（过去式或过去分词）

items.example: He is analyzing the latest sales figures.
items.exampleCN: 他正在分析最新的销售数据。

items.meaning: the process or result of analyzing
items.example: Her analysis of the poem was careful and original.
items.exampleCN: 她对这首诗的分析细致而有原创性。

items.meaningCN: 分析师；分析者（-ist 表示人）
items.example: The analyst warned that the trend could reverse.
items.exampleCN: 分析师警告说趋势可能反转。

items.meaning: relating to analysis; skilled at separating things
items.meaningCN: 分析的；善于分析的（-ical 构成形容词）
items.exampleCN: 她有一颗善于分析的大脑。
我们以分析的方式处理这个问题。

items.meaningCN: 可分析的（-able 表示“能被……的”）
items.example: The data is analyzable with standard software.
items.exampleCN: 这些数据可以用标准软件分析。

items.example: The recording was unanalyzable until the background noise was removed.
items.exampleCN: 在去掉背景噪音之前，这段录音无法分析。

items.meaningCN: 对某人进行精神分析（psycho- 表示“心灵”）
items.example: The doctor psychoanalyzed the patient over several years.
items.exampleCN: 医生对这位病人进行了数年的精神分析。

items.meaning: to analyze again, often with new methods
items.meaningCN: 重新分析（re- 表示“再次”）
items.example: The team reanalyzed the old data with a new model.
items.exampleCN: 团队用新模型重新分析了旧数据。

items.meaning: to analyze something more than is useful
items.example: Do not overanalyze a friendly remark.
items.exampleCN: 不要把一句友好的话过度解读。

definition_zh: 无政府状态；混乱；无秩序
definition_en: a state of society without government or order; complete confusion and disorder
core_image: 没人管的红绿灯路口：车流横冲直撞，乱成一团
scene: 停电整夜后，这座城市的十字路口没人指挥。After the power cut, the crossroads fell into complete anarchy, with cars honking from every direction.
sceneCN: 这里的 anarchy 是「混乱、无秩序」（第 2 个义项：彻底的混乱）；句意是停电后十字路口彻底失序，各个方向的汽车都在按喇叭。

pos.zh: 无政府状态；混乱；无秩序

derivatives.zh: 由 anarchy 加形容词后缀 -ic 构成，义为「无政府的；混乱无序的」
由 anarchy 加施动者后缀 -ist 构成，义为「无政府主义者」
由 anarchy 加后缀 -ism 构成，义为「无政府主义（政治学说）」

senses.title: A society without government
senses.definition: a situation in a country or organization where there is no government, no authority, or no system of control
senses.definitionCN: 国家或组织中没有政府、没有权威、没有管理体系的局面
senses.example: The collapse of the government left the country in anarchy.
senses.exampleCN: 政府垮台使这个国家陷入无政府状态。
senses.why: The Greek prefix an- means without and arkhos means ruler, so the original sense is literally the absence of a ruler.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语前缀 an- 表示「没有」，arkhos 表示「统治者」，本义就是字面上的「没有统治者」，即无政府状态。

senses.title: Complete confusion and disorder
senses.definition: a situation of total confusion where nobody is in control and normal rules do not work
senses.definitionCN: 彻底混乱、无人掌控、正常规则失效的局面
senses.example: The classroom descended into anarchy when the teacher left.
senses.exampleCN: 老师一离开，教室就乱成了一锅粥。
senses.why: When no ruler or rule remains, ordinary activities lose all order, so the word extends from politics to any kind of chaos.
senses.whyCN: 没有了管理者与规则，日常活动便失去一切秩序，于是词义从政治领域扩展到任何混乱场面。

senses.title: Absence of authority between groups
senses.definition: in political theory, the condition in which no higher authority exists above independent states or groups
senses.definitionCN: 政治理论中，指独立国家或群体之上不存在更高权威的状态
senses.example: International relations are often described as an anarchy of sovereign states.
senses.exampleCN: 国际关系常被描述为主权国家之间的无法度状态。
senses.why: Political theorists took the literal meaning, no world ruler over states, and made it a technical term of the discipline.
senses.whyCN: 政治理论家取其字面义「没有一个凌驾各国之上的统治者」，将其变成学科术语，用于描述国际体系。

senses.title: The ideal of a stateless society
senses.definition: the political ideal of a society organized voluntarily without a state or coercive authority
senses.definitionCN: 指一种政治理想：社会在没有国家或强制权威的情况下自愿组织运转
senses.example: Some thinkers believed that anarchy could be a just and peaceful order.
senses.exampleCN: 一些思想家认为无政府状态可以是公正而和平的秩序。
senses.why: Anarchists read the absence of a ruler not as chaos but as freedom, turning the neutral condition into a positive ideal.
senses.whyCN: 无政府主义者把「没有统治者」不是读作混乱而是读作自由，于是把这个中性状态变成了正面的政治理想。

intro.en: Anarchy comes from Greek anarkhia, built on an- without and arkhos ruler.
intro.cn: anarchy 来自希腊语 anarkhia，由 an-（没有）加 arkhos（统治者）构成。

items.en: The reconstructed root *arkh- meant to begin or to lead, later to rule.
items.cn: 重构词根 *arkh- 表示「开始、带头」，后引申为「统治」。

items.en: Greek arkhos meant ruler, and the prefix an- negated it, giving anarkhos, without a ruler; the abstract noun was anarkhia.
items.cn: 希腊语 arkhos 意为「统治者」，前缀 an- 加以否定得 anarkhos「无统治者的」，抽象名词为 anarkhia。

items.en: Plato and other writers used anarkhia both for the absence of magistrates and for disorder in a city.
items.cn: 柏拉图等作家用 anarkhia 兼指「官员缺位」与「城邦的混乱」两种情形。

items.en: The word passed through Latin anarchia and French anarchie before entering English.
items.cn: 该词经拉丁语 anarchia 与法语 anarchie 传入英语。

items.en: English anarchy first appears in the 1530s, describing states without lawful rule.
items.cn: 英语 anarchy 最早见于 1530 年代，用于描述缺乏合法统治的国家状态。

items.en: In the 19th century the word also named the political doctrine of anarchism, which sought a society without a state.
items.cn: 19 世纪起，该词也用于指称无政府主义学说，即主张建立无国家社会的政治思想。

note.en: Anarchy is often confused with anarchism, and contrasted with order and government.
note.cn: anarchy 常与 anarchism 混淆，并与 order、government 形成对照。

entries.definition: the political doctrine that opposes the state
entries.definitionCN: 无政府主义，由 anarchy 加 -ism 构成的学说名称

entries.definition: a person who believes in abolishing government
entries.definitionCN: 无政府主义者，指持有该主张的人

entries.definition: rule by one person such as a king or queen
entries.definitionCN: 君主制，与 anarchy 共用希腊语词根 arkhos（统治者），前缀相反

entries.definition: rule by a small group of people
entries.definitionCN: 寡头统治，同以 arkhos 为词根，指少数人掌权

entries.definition: complete disorder and confusion
entries.definitionCN: 混沌、混乱，强调毫无结构，不带政治含义

entries.definition: a state without laws being obeyed
entries.definitionCN: 无法无天的状态，强调法律不被遵守

entries.definition: a lack of order or organization
entries.definitionCN: 紊乱、无序，语气较弱，泛指秩序缺失

entries.definition: a state of great disturbance and confusion
entries.definitionCN: 骚乱、动荡，强调激烈的动荡感

entries.definition: an organized and controlled condition
entries.definitionCN: 秩序，是 anarchy 混乱义项的直接反义

normalIntro.en: Break anarchy into an- and arkhos to remember its Greek shape.
normalIntro.cn: 把 anarchy 拆成 an- 和 arkhos 来记住它的希腊语结构。

normal.en: an- means without, as in anonymous, without a name.
normal.cn: 前缀 an- 表示「没有」，如 anonymous「匿名的」就是「没有名字」。

normal.en: arkhos means ruler, the same root seen in monarchy.
normal.cn: 词根 arkhos 表示「统治者」，monarchy（君主制）用的就是它。

normal.en: So anarchy literally means without a ruler.
normal.cn: 所以 anarchy 字面意思就是「没有统治者」。

normal.en: Compare monarchy, oligarchy, hierarchy: all name systems of rule.
normal.cn: 对比 monarchy、oligarchy、hierarchy：都以 -archy 结尾，命名各种统治体系。

normal.en: anarchic is the adjective, as in an anarchic classroom.
normal.cn: anarchic 是形容词，如 an anarchic classroom「乱哄哄的课堂」。

abstract.en: Picture a traffic light gone dark: everyone drives as they please.
abstract.cn: 想象红绿灯全灭：人人想怎么开就怎么开。

abstract.en: See an empty throne and a crowd with no one to obey.
abstract.cn: 想象一张空王座，人群无人可服从。

abstract.en: Feel a classroom after the teacher vanishes: papers fly, voices rise.
abstract.cn: 感受老师消失后的教室：纸片乱飞、人声鼎沸。

examples.en: The empire collapsed into anarchy after the emperor was deposed.
examples.cn: 皇帝被废黜后，帝国陷入无政府状态。

examples.en: Without clear rules, the meeting dissolved into anarchy.
examples.cn: 没有明确规则，会议乱成了一团。

examples.en: Critics warned that the new policy would create anarchy in the market.
examples.cn: 批评者警告新政策会造成市场失序。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿那惧」——阿婆那都不敢管，谁也不惧权威，没了统治者就是无政府状态：anarchy。

root: 希腊语前缀 an-（没有，元音前否定形式）+ 词根 arkh-（开始、统治，arkhos 统治者）→ anarkhos「无统治者的」→ anarkhia「无统治状态」。同族词 monarchy（君主制）、oligarchy（寡头制）、hierarchy（等级制）。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the literal absence of a ruler, through general disorder, to the technical and the ideal uses.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从字面的「没有统治者」出发，经泛化的「混乱」，延伸到政治理论的术语义与无政府主义的理想义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: no ruler, no rules, everyone on their own
core.cn: 核心意象：没有统治者，没有规则，人人自行其是

branches.en: A society literally without a government
branches.cn: 字面上的无政府社会状态

branches.en: Everyday chaos when nobody is in control
branches.cn: 无人掌控时日常生活的混乱

branches.en: States facing each other with no higher power
branches.cn: 各国之上没有更高权威的国际格局

branches.en: Reading the absence of the state as an ideal
branches.cn: 把国家的缺席读作政治理想

branches.en: From missing government to total confusion
branches.cn: 从政府缺位滑向彻底混乱的引申路径

intro.en: Anarchy is built on the Greek root arkhos plus the negative prefix an-.
intro.cn: anarchy 由希腊语词根 arkhos 加否定前缀 an- 构成。

latinIntro.en: The -archy family names systems of rule; Greek roots combine with different prefixes.
latinIntro.cn: -archy 词族命名各种统治体系；希腊语词根搭配不同前缀构成新词。

definition_zh: 令人憎恶的事物；被诅咒的人；革出教门的惩罚
definition_en: something or someone that is intensely disliked or detested; a formal curse by a church
core_image: 被全村人指着的罪人：人人避之唯恐不及
scene: 在那个小镇上，说谎被视为最不可饶恕的恶习。In that town, lying was anathema to everyone, and no liar was ever trusted again.
sceneCN: 这里的 anathema 是「人人憎恶之事」（第 1 个义项：极其厌恶的东西）；句意是在那个镇上撒谎为人人所不齿，撒谎者再也不会被信任。

pos.zh: 令人憎恶的事物；诅咒；革出教门

derivatives.zh: 由 anathema 加动词后缀 -ize 构成，义为「诅咒；将…革出教门」
由 anathematize 加名词后缀 -ion 构成，义为「诅咒的行为；革出教门」
由 anathema 加形容词后缀 -ic 构成，义为「受诅咒的；遭憎恶的」

senses.title: Something intensely detested
senses.definition: a thing or an idea that someone detests strongly, as if it were cursed
senses.definitionCN: 某人极为憎恶、视若诅咒般避之不及的事物或观念
senses.example: Raising taxes is anathema to most voters.
senses.exampleCN: 加税是大多数选民深恶痛绝的事。
senses.why: The churchly curse became a metaphor: whatever is cursed is hated, so the word drifted to any detested thing.
senses.whyCN: 宗教诅咒变成比喻：被诅咒的即是人见人恨的，词义因此泛化到任何令人深恶痛绝的事物。

senses.title: A person who is cursed or detested
senses.titleCN: 被诅咒的人；遭憎恶的人
senses.definition: a person who is cursed or regarded with intense dislike by a group
senses.definitionCN: 被诅咒的、或被某个群体极度厌恶的人
senses.example: The traitor became an anathema to his own family.
senses.exampleCN: 这个叛徒成了连家人都憎恶的人。
senses.why: A curse can fall on people as well as things, so the noun also names the cursed person himself.
senses.whyCN: 诅咒既可以加于物也可以加于人，因此该名词也指那个被诅咒、遭唾弃的人。

senses.title: A formal church curse
senses.definition: a solemn curse pronounced by church authority, especially one that excommunicates a person
senses.definitionCN: 由教会权威郑重宣布的诅咒，尤指将某人逐出教会的惩罚
senses.example: In medieval times, an anathema cut a sinner off from all sacraments.
senses.exampleCN: 在中世纪，一道绝罚令使罪人不得参与一切圣事。
senses.why: This is the original technical sense: the Greek thing set up, later a devoted offering, then devoted to destruction.
senses.whyCN: 这是原本的专门含义：希腊语中「献置之物」先指献给神的祭品，后转为献给毁灭的诅咒之物。

intro.en: Anathema comes from Greek anatithenai, to set up as an offering, whose noun anathema later meant a thing cursed.
intro.cn: anathema 源于希腊语 anatithenai「献置」，其名词 anathema 后来转为「受诅咒之物」。

items.en: The root *dheh1- meant to set or to put, seen also in English do.
items.cn: 词根 *dheh1- 表示「放置、安置」，英语 do 也出自同一词根。

items.en: Anatithenai meant to set up or dedicate; the noun anathema first meant an offering set up in a temple.
items.cn: 希腊语 anatithenai 意为「献置、奉献」；名词 anathema 最初指供奉在神庙中的祭品。

items.en: In the Greek Bible, anathema translated a Hebrew term for something devoted to destruction, so it took on the sense of an accursed thing.
items.cn: 在希腊文《圣经》中，anathema 用来翻译希伯来语「当灭之物」，于是染上了「受诅咒」的强烈贬义。

items.en: Church Latin borrowed anathema as the formal term for excommunication and condemnation.
items.cn: 教会拉丁语借入 anathema，作为「绝罚、谴责」的正式术语。

items.en: English anathema appears in the 1520s in the churchly sense, and by the 17th century also named any detested thing or person.
items.cn: 英语 anathema 于 1520 年代以宗教义进入英语，到 17 世纪也用来指任何令人憎恶的人或事物。

note.en: Anathema looks like anthem but is unrelated; it sits near abhorrence and bane in meaning.
note.cn: anathema 拼写与 anthem 相近但词源无关；语义上与 abhorrence、bane 相近。

entries.definition: a solemn song of praise or loyalty
entries.definitionCN: 颂歌；国歌，只是拼写相近，词源不同，来自古英语 antefn

entries.definition: to curse or formally condemn
entries.definitionCN: 诅咒；革出教门，由 anathema 派生的动词

entries.definition: a lack of red blood cells
entries.definitionCN: 贫血，同为 an- 开头的希腊借词，但词根不同只是拼写相近

entries.definition: a library or cultural institution
entries.definitionCN: 图书馆；文艺学会，与雅典娜相关，与 anathema 无词源关系

entries.definition: a feeling of intense disgust
entries.definitionCN: 憎恶；深恶痛绝，强调情感本身

entries.definition: a cause of great distress or death
entries.definitionCN: 祸根；毒物，强调造成毁坏的原因

entries.definition: a solemn utterance calling for harm
entries.definitionCN: 诅咒，指诅咒的言语或行为，anathema 是其宗教化的正式形式

entries.definition: official exclusion from a church
entries.definitionCN: 绝罚；逐出教会，与 anathema 的宗教专门义对应

entries.definition: an outcast rejected by society
entries.definitionCN: 被社会排斥者，与「遭憎恶的人」义项相近

normalIntro.en: Split anathema into an- and thema to hold its Greek shape in mind.
normalIntro.cn: 把 anathema 拆成 an- 和 thema 来记住它的希腊语形状。

normal.en: ana- is a Greek prefix meaning up or back, as in analogy.
normal.cn: 前缀 ana- 表示「向上、回返」，如 analogy 中的用法。

normal.en: thema means something laid down or set up, the same root as theme.
normal.cn: thema 表示「被放置之物」，与 theme（主题）同根。

normal.en: Set up before the god first meant an offering, then a cursed thing.
normal.cn: 「献于神前」最初指祭品，后来转为受诅咒之物。

normal.en: The verb is anathematize, to pronounce the curse.
normal.cn: 动词 anathematize 意为「宣布诅咒、革出教门」。

normal.en: The common phrase is be anathema to someone.
normal.cn: 常见搭配是 be anathema to someone「令某人深恶痛绝」。

abstract.en: Picture a figure pointed at by the whole village, unwelcome everywhere.
abstract.cn: 想象一个被全村人指着的人，走到哪儿都不受欢迎。

abstract.en: See garlic held up to a vampire: the very thing he cannot bear.
abstract.cn: 想象大蒜举到吸血鬼面前：那是他最无法忍受之物。

abstract.en: Feel a word so heavy that saying it makes the room go silent.
abstract.cn: 感受一个词重得让整个房间瞬间安静下来的分量。

examples.en: Violence of any kind is anathema to her.
examples.cn: 任何形式的暴力都令她深恶痛绝。

examples.en: The council pronounced an anathema against the rebels.
examples.cn: 公会议对叛乱者宣布了绝罚。

examples.en: For a free-market economist, price controls are anathema.
examples.cn: 对自由市场经济学家来说，价格管制是不能容忍的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿那-thema」——阿婆那本书被当成诅咒之物，人人憎恶：anathema，令人憎恶的东西。

root: 希腊语 ana-（向上、回返）+ thema（被放置之物，词根 *dheh1-「放置」）→ anathema「献置之物」，经《圣经》希腊语转义为「当灭之物、受诅咒者」，再经教会拉丁语进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the formal church curse, to the cursed person, to anything detested.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从教会的正式诅咒出发，到被诅咒之人，再泛化为任何令人憎恶的事物。

core.cn: 核心意象：被众人搁置并诅咒的东西

branches.cn: 原本的教会正式诅咒

branches.en: The person the curse falls upon
branches.cn: 诅咒所加于其身的人

branches.cn: 泛化的令人憎恶的事物或观念

branches.cn: 被整个群体避之唯恐不及

branches.cn: 从宗教禁令到日常憎恶的引申路径

latinIntro.cn: 该词经教会拉丁语传递，相关形式保留希腊语形状。

definition_zh: 解剖学；身体结构；解剖；剖析
definition_en: the scientific study of the structure of bodies, or the structure of a body or system itself
core_image: 一具被细心分层的躯干示意图，肌肉、血管与骨骼逐层揭开
scene: 医学院的新生第一学期就要背骨头。Anatomy students spend the first term learning every bone of the hand.
sceneCN: 这里 anatomy 指「解剖学」（第 1 个义项：研究生物体结构的学科）；句意：解剖学学生第一学期要学完手部每一块骨头。图中可辨识物件：分层人体图、手部骨骼标本、标注签。

pos.zh: 解剖学；身体结构；解剖（行为）；剖析（可数时指某生物或某系统的结构）

derivatives.zh: 解剖的；结构上的

senses.title: The Science of Structure
senses.titleCN: 解剖学：研究身体结构的学科
senses.definition: the scientific study of the structure of living bodies
senses.definitionCN: 研究生物体结构的科学
senses.example: Anatomy students spend the first term learning every bone of the hand.
senses.exampleCN: 解剖学学生第一学期要学完手部每一块骨头。
senses.why: Greek ana- meant 'up, throughout' and temnein meant 'to cut'. Anatomē was a cutting-up, and the name of the act became the name of the science that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 希腊前缀 ana- 意为「向上、遍及」，temnein 意为「切」。anatomē 就是「切开」，这个动作的名称后来变成了从事该动作的学科名称。

senses.title: Body Structure Itself
senses.titleCN: 身体结构：部件如何安排
senses.definition: the actual structure of a body, its parts and their arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 身体实际的结构、各部分及其排列
senses.example: The dolphin's anatomy shows that its flipper is a modified arm.
senses.exampleCN: 海豚的身体结构表明，它的鳍肢是改造过的手臂。
senses.why: The same noun names the object as well as the study. When a biologist says 'the anatomy of the dolphin', the cutting has become a description of what was found.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词既指学科也指对象；当生物学家说 the anatomy of the dolphin 时，「切」已经变成了对所见之物的描述。

senses.title: The Act of Dissection
senses.titleCN: 解剖：切开并分离的动作
senses.definition: the act or practice of cutting a body apart to study it
senses.definitionCN: 为研究而把身体切开的动作或做法
senses.example: The anatomy of the specimen took the whole afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 对这份标本的解剖花了一整个下午。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: the physical cutting. Modern laboratories may use imaging instead, but the word still remembers the knife.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：实际的切割。现代实验室可能改用成像技术，但这个词仍记得那把刀。

senses.title: Detailed Analysis
senses.titleCN: 剖析：把一个整体拆开来看
senses.definition: a detailed examination of the parts of a thing or idea
senses.definitionCN: 对事物或观念的各个部分所作的细致检查
senses.example: The book is an anatomy of how rumours spread.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书是对谣言如何传播的一次剖析。
senses.why: The metaphor is exact: to understand a whole, take it apart part by part. Analysts therefore borrow the anatomist's word for structures that are not biological.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻非常贴切：要理解一个整体，就把它一部分一部分拆开。因此分析者借解剖学家的词，用于并非生物的结构。

senses.title: The Human Body
senses.definition: the human body, especially in informal or humorous use
senses.definitionCN: 人的身体，尤用于口语或戏谑
senses.example: He fell and bruised his entire anatomy.
senses.exampleCN: 他摔了一跤，全身都碰伤了。
senses.why: Because anatomy studies the body, the noun can stand for the body itself. The tone is usually light, as if the speaker were looking at the body from outside.
senses.whyCN: 因为解剖学研究身体，这个名词可以代指身体本身；语气通常轻松，仿佛说话者从外部打量这具身体。

senses.title: Plant and Animal Structure
senses.titleCN: 动植物结构：非人体的解剖
senses.definition: the structure of plants or animals studied as a field
senses.definitionCN: 作为研究领域的植物或动物结构
senses.example: Plant anatomy explains why stems bend toward light.
senses.exampleCN: 植物解剖学解释了茎为何向光弯曲。
senses.why: The science is not limited to people. Comparative anatomy compares species, and plant anatomy studies tissues; the same cutting-up logic applies.
senses.whyCN: 这门科学并不限于人。比较解剖学比较各物种，植物解剖学研究组织；「切开来看」的逻辑是一样的。

senses.title: Structure of an Institution
senses.titleCN: 机构的结构：组织如何构成
senses.definition: the internal structure and working parts of an organization or system
senses.definitionCN: 组织或系统的内部结构与运作部件
senses.example: The report examined the anatomy of the health service.
senses.exampleCN: 该报告考察了医疗服务体系的结构。
senses.why: Institutions have parts that can be mapped like organs. The word implies that the parts are interdependent, so a change in one shows up elsewhere.
senses.whyCN: 机构有可以像器官一样被描绘的部件；这个词暗示各部件相互依赖，因此改一处就会在别处显现。

senses.title: The Anatomy Course
senses.titleCN: 解剖学课程：作为科目的解剖
senses.definition: the subject or course taught under this name
senses.definitionCN: 以解剖学为名讲授的科目或课程
senses.example: She passed anatomy but failed physiology.
senses.exampleCN: 她解剖学通过了，生理学却没过。
senses.why: In medical schools the science becomes a subject with exams. Names of disciplines often work this way: biology is both a field and a class at nine o'clock.
senses.whyCN: 在医学院，这门科学变成有考试的科目。学科名称常如此运作：biology 既是研究领域，也是九点钟的那堂课。

intro.en: Anatomy comes from Greek anatomē 'a cutting up', from ana- 'up, throughout' and temnein 'to cut'. Latin borrowed it as anatomia, and English took it in the sixteenth century; the exact date is approximate.
intro.cn: anatomy 出自希腊 anatomē「切开」，由 ana-「向上、遍及」与 temnein「切」构成。拉丁语借作 anatomia，英语于十六世纪引入；确切年代为约数。

items.en: Temnein meant 'to cut'. From it came tomos 'a cut' and the adjective -tomos, which survives in English compounds such as appendectomy and lobotomy.
items.cn: temnein 意为「切」，由此产生 tomos「切口」与形容词 -tomos；后者在英语复合词中留存，如 appendectomy（阑尾切除术）、lobotomy（脑叶切断术）。

items.en: The same root produced atomos, 'uncuttable', from a- 'not' plus tomos. Democritus used it for the smallest indivisible piece of matter. Anatomy and atom are therefore opposites built from one verb: one cuts up, the other cannot be cut.
items.cn: 同一词根产生 atomos「不可切的」，由 a-「不」加 tomos 构成；德谟克利特用它指不可再分的最小物质。因此 anatomy 与 atom 是由同一个动词造出的反义对：一个切开，一个不可切。

items.en: Anatomē meant 'a cutting up, dissection'. Greek medicine used it for the procedure of opening a body to learn its parts, not for the parts themselves.
items.cn: anatomē 意为「切开、解剖」。希腊医学用它指打开身体以了解其部件的操作，而不是指部件本身。

items.en: Latin anatomia kept both the act and the science. Medieval and Renaissance anatomists added the sense 'the structure so revealed', which English inherited.
items.cn: 拉丁 anatomia 同时保留行为与学科两义；中世纪与文艺复兴时期的解剖学家又添上「由此揭示的结构」这一含义，英语继承了它。

items.en: From the seventeenth century English extended anatomy to the parts of anything, from a poem to a government. The metaphor survives because every whole can be taken apart.
items.cn: 自十七世纪起，英语把 anatomy 扩展到任何事物的部件，从一首诗到一个政府。这个比喻之所以存活，是因为任何整体都可以拆开。

note.en: The first group separates members of the Greek cutting family that look alike. The second holds near-synonyms for study, body and analysis.
note.cn: 第一组区分希腊「切」词族中形近的成员；第二组是表示研究、身体与分析的近义词。

entries.definition: The smallest unit of an element, named by Greek atomos 'uncuttable'. It is the exact opposite prefix to anatomy, which is about cutting up.
entries.definitionCN: 元素的最小单位，名称来自希腊 atomos「不可切的」；它的前缀恰与 anatomy「切开」相反。

entries.definition: Relating to anatomy or to body structure. It modifies nouns such as structure, position and model.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指与解剖学或身体结构有关的；修饰 structure、position、model 等名词。

entries.definition: A person who studies or practises anatomy. It names the human agent, not the field.
entries.definitionCN: 研究或从事解剖的人；命名的是人，而非领域。

entries.definition: The act of cutting something apart for study. It is the procedure, while anatomy can also be the science or the structure.
entries.definitionCN: 为研究而切开某物的行为；它是操作过程，而 anatomy 还可指学科或结构。

entries.definition: The study of how body parts work. Anatomy asks what the parts are; physiology asks what they do.
entries.definitionCN: 研究身体部件如何运作的学科；anatomy 问部件是什么，physiology 问它们做什么。

entries.definition: The study of form, especially in biology and linguistics. It is broader than anatomy and does not imply dissection.
entries.definitionCN: 研究形式的学科，尤用于生物学与语言学；比 anatomy 更宽，且不暗示解剖。

entries.definition: The way parts are put together. It is the neutral word; anatomy adds the biological or systematic flavour.
entries.definitionCN: 各部分的组合方式；是中性词，而 anatomy 增添了生物学或系统性的色彩。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: ana- 'up, throughout' + temnein 'cut' + -y: the cutting-up that reveals structure.
normal.cn: ana-「向上、遍及」+ temnein「切」+ -y：揭示结构的切开。

normal.en: The family runs anatomical, anatomically, anatomist, anatomize, and the -tomy words such as appendectomy.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 anatomical、anatomically、anatomist、anatomize，以及 appendectomy 一类 -tomy 词。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the use: human anatomy, comparative anatomy, plant anatomy, gross anatomy.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：人体解剖学、比较解剖学、植物解剖学、大体解剖学。

normal.en: atom is the same root with the opposite prefix: 'not cuttable' against 'cut up'.
normal.cn: atom 是同一词根加相反前缀：不可切，对比切开。

normal.en: anatomy asks what the parts are; physiology asks what they do.
normal.cn: anatomy 问部件是什么，physiology 问部件做什么。

abstract.en: Picture a watch opened on a table, every wheel laid out in order.
abstract.cn: 想象一只表在桌上被打开，每个齿轮都按顺序摆好。

abstract.en: Picture a map of a city printed as layers: roads, pipes, then power lines.
abstract.cn: 想象一张城市地图分层印出：先是道路，再是管道，然后是电线。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence taken apart word by word to see how it holds together.
abstract.cn: 想象一个句子被逐词拆开，以看清它如何组合。

examples.en: Human anatomy has changed little since the Renaissance.
examples.cn: 自文艺复兴以来，人体解剖学变化不大。

examples.en: The anatomy of a frog is often taught before that of a mammal.
examples.cn: 教学上常先讲青蛙的解剖结构，再讲哺乳动物。

examples.en: Her paper offers an anatomy of the failure rather than a remedy.
examples.cn: 她的论文对这次失败作了剖析，而没有给出补救办法。

dict_mnemonic.text: ana（向上、分开）+ tomy（切）→ 分开切开来研究 → 解剖学；身体结构

root: 希腊 ana-「向上、遍及」+ temnein「切」→ anatomē「切开、解剖」→ 拉丁 anatomia → 英语 anatomy；同根 atom 意为「不可切的」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one act of cutting: the science, the structure revealed, the cutting itself, metaphorical analysis, the body in speech, plant and animal bodies, institutional structure and the school subject.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都沿着「切开」这一动作展开：学科、被揭示的结构、切割本身、比喻性的剖析、口语中的身体、动植物身体、机构结构与学校科目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body opened layer by layer, each part labelled.
core.cn: 核心意象：一具被逐层打开、每个部件都带标签的身体。

branches.en: THE ACT AND THE SCIENCE: the physical cutting and the discipline that grew from it.
branches.cn: 动作与学科：实际的切割，以及由它生长出来的学科。

branches.en: WHAT THE CUT REVEALS: human, animal and plant bodies are described part by part.
branches.cn: 切开后所见：人、动物与植物的身体被逐部件描述。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR: books, rumours and institutions can be taken apart the same way.
branches.cn: 比喻延伸：书籍、谣言与机构也能以同样方式拆解。

branches.en: THE BODY IN SPEECH: informal use lets the noun stand for the whole body.
branches.cn: 口语中的身体：非正式用法让该名词代指整个身体。

branches.en: THE SUBJECT: in medical schools the science becomes a course with examinations.
branches.cn: 科目：在医学院，这门科学变成有考试的课程。

intro.en: Anatomy is a Greek compound: a prefix of opening, the verb 'to cut', and a noun ending. English also uses the combining form -tomy for surgical cuttings.
intro.cn: anatomy 是希腊语复合词：表示打开的动词前缀、动词「切」，以及名词词尾。英语还用构词成分 -tomy 表示外科切开。

latinIntro.en: Latin anatomia came from Greek anatomē. The Latinized form supplies anatomy, anatomical, anatomist and anatomize; the Greek root tom- supplies appendectomy, tonsillectomy and lobotomy.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 anatomia 来自希腊 anatomē；拉丁化形式衍生 anatomy、anatomical、anatomist、anatomize；希腊词根 tom- 衍生 appendectomy、tonsillectomy、lobotomy。

items.meaning: a cutting up; the structure revealed
items.example: The anatomy of the insect was drawn in detail.
items.exampleCN: 这只昆虫的解剖结构被详细绘制。

items.example: The anatomical model comes apart in twelve pieces.
items.exampleCN: 这个解剖模型可拆成十二块。

items.example: The two joints are anatomically identical.
items.exampleCN: 这两个关节在结构上完全相同。

items.example: The anatomist named the muscle in 1840.
items.exampleCN: 这位解剖学家在 1840 年给该肌肉命名。

items.meaning: to dissect or analyse in detail
items.example: He anatomized the argument line by line.
items.exampleCN: 他逐行剖析了这场论证。

items.example: An atom of carbon has six protons.
items.exampleCN: 一个碳原子有六个质子。

items.structure: tomos (a cut, a slice) + English form
items.meaning: a large book, a 'slice' of writing
items.example: The library owns a rare tome on beetles.
items.exampleCN: 图书馆藏有一部罕见的甲虫专著。

items.meaning: a cutting short; a perfect summary
items.example: The small town is the epitome of quiet.
items.exampleCN: 这个小镇是宁静的缩影。

latinEntries.meaning: dissection; the science of the body

latinEntries.structure: atomus, -i (f. or m., Greek loan in Latin)

definition_zh: 轶事；趣闻；短小的纪实故事
definition_en: a short, usually amusing story about a real person or incident
core_image: 茶桌边有人讲起一件亲历的小事，听的人都笑了
scene: 饭桌上，老人讲起自己第一次进城时迷路的经历。She told an anecdote about her first day at work that made everyone laugh.
sceneCN: 这里 anecdote 是「轶事、趣闻」（第 1 个义项：关于真实人物或事件的短故事）；句意为她讲了一件上班第一天的趣事，把大家都逗笑了。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「轶事式的；传闻的」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「根据轶事传闻地」
由本词加表示人的后缀构成，义为「爱讲轶事的人」

senses.title: A short story about something real
senses.titleCN: 关于真实事件的短故事
senses.definition: a brief account of a real incident or person, often entertaining
senses.definitionCN: 对真实事件或人物的简短叙述，常带有趣味
senses.example: She told an anecdote about her first day at work.
senses.exampleCN: 她讲了上班第一天的趣事。
senses.why: Greek anekdota meant 'things not published'; the word named private material later told aloud, and it kept the tone of a story shared rather than a formal record.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 anekdota 意为「未发表的东西」；这个词原指后来被口头讲述的私人材料，因此保留了「分享故事」而非正式记录的语调。

senses.title: An unverified story
senses.definition: a story passed on without proof of its accuracy
senses.definitionCN: 没有证据证明其准确性便流传的说法
senses.example: The anecdote spread through the office before anyone checked it.
senses.exampleCN: 还没人核实，这件传闻就在办公室里传开了。
senses.why: Because such stories circulate by word of mouth, the word often carries a warning that the details may be unverified.
senses.whyCN: 由于这类故事靠口耳相传，这个词常带有「细节未必可靠」的提醒。

senses.title: An illustrative brief narrative
senses.definition: a short narrative used to make a point clearer
senses.definitionCN: 用来把论点讲得更清楚的短叙事
senses.example: He opened the lecture with an anecdote about Newton.
senses.exampleCN: 他以一则牛顿的轶事开场。
senses.why: Speakers borrow a small true story to carry a large idea, so the anecdote becomes a tool of explanation.
senses.whyCN: 演讲者借一个小而真实的故事承载大观念，于是轶事成了说明工具。

senses.title: Collected stories
senses.definition: a collection of such stories, often in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 这类故事的集合，常用复数形式
senses.example: The book is full of anecdotes about village life.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书里满是乡村生活的趣闻。
senses.why: Once many small stories are gathered, the plural names the whole collection rather than one telling.
senses.whyCN: 当许多小故事被收集起来，复数形式就指整部合集，而不是单次讲述。

intro.en: Anecdote goes back to a Greek word for things not published, a title given to a collection of private stories.
intro.cn: anecdote 可追溯到希腊语中表示「未发表之物」的词，那是一本私人故事集的标题。

items.en: The Greek prefix an- means 'not', the negative counterpart of a-.
items.cn: 希腊语前缀 an- 意为「不」，是 a- 的否定形式。

items.en: ekdidonai meant 'to give out, publish', built from ek- 'out' and didonai 'to give'.
items.cn: ekdidonai 意为「交出、发表」，由 ek-（向外）与 didonai（给）构成。

items.en: ta anekdota meant 'things not published'; it was used as a title for private memoirs.
items.cn: ta anekdota 意为「未发表的东西」，曾被用作私人回忆录的标题。

items.en: French anecdote entered learned use in the seventeenth century with the sense of a short unpublished story.
items.cn: 法语 anecdote 在十七世纪进入学术用法，指未公开的短故事。

items.en: English adopted the word for a short story about a real person, often told for interest.
items.cn: 英语吸收该词，指关于真实人物的短故事，常为趣味而讲。

items.en: Modern usage extends anecdote to unverified gossip and to stories used as examples in speeches.
items.cn: 现代用法把 anecdote 扩展到未经证实的传闻，以及演讲中用作例子的故事。

note.en: The first group gathers the adjective, adverb, and person noun from the same family; the second gathers words for short narratives.
note.cn: 第一组收同族的形容词、副词与人物名词；第二组收表示短篇叙事的词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning based on personal stories rather than proof.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「轶事式的、传闻的」，基于个人故事而非证据。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning 'by way of anecdote or unverified report'.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「根据轶事传闻地」。

entries.definition: A person who collects or tells anecdotes.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「爱讲轶事的人、轶事收集者」。

entries.definition: A general word for an account of events, real or invented.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「故事」，泛指对真实或虚构事件的叙述。

entries.definition: A narrative, often old or fictional and told aloud.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「故事、传说」，常指古老或虚构的口头叙事。

entries.definition: A factual description of an event.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「叙述、描述」，对事件的事实性说明。

entries.definition: A long, often exaggerated story told informally.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，非正式用法，义为「长篇故事」，常带夸张。

entries.definition: A single event or short period in a longer history.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「插曲、片段」，较长历史中的单个事件或短时期。

normalIntro.en: The normal hooks use the Greek 'not published' origin and the common telling collocations; the abstract hooks picture the story being shared.
normalIntro.cn: 常规记忆点用希腊语「未发表」的来源与常见讲述搭配；抽象记忆点想象故事被分享的场景。

normal.en: Anecdote began as Greek 'things not published', so it still feels like a story let out of private life.
normal.cn: anecdote 原指希腊语「未发表之物」，因此仍像从私人生活中放出来的故事。

normal.en: Tell an anecdote and a personal anecdote are the standard patterns.
normal.cn: tell an anecdote 与 a personal anecdote 是标准结构。

normal.en: Anecdotal evidence is the adjective phrase for proof based on stories.
normal.cn: anecdotal evidence 是用故事作证据的形容词短语。

normal.en: The plural anecdotes often names a collection of such stories.
normal.cn: 复数 anecdotes 常指这类故事的合集。

normal.en: An anecdote differs from a joke: it claims to be true and usually has a point.
normal.cn: anecdote 与笑话不同：它声称真实，且通常有寓意。

abstract.en: Picture a circle of people around a table, one voice telling a small true story.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈人围坐桌边，一个声音讲着一件真实的小事。

abstract.en: Picture a folded note marked 'not published', later read aloud.
abstract.cn: 想象一张写着「未发表」的折纸，后来被当众读出。

abstract.en: Picture a speaker opening a lecture with one short story before the slides.
abstract.cn: 想象演讲者在放幻灯片前先讲一个小故事。

examples.en: He told a funny anecdote about his first flight.
examples.cn: 他讲了一件第一次坐飞机的趣事。

examples.en: The article begins with an anecdote about a village teacher.
examples.cn: 文章以一则乡村教师的轶事开头。

examples.en: Her anecdotes made the long journey seem short.
examples.cn: 她的趣闻让漫长的旅程显得很短。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安尼克多特」——一桌人围坐，有人翻出一件没发表过的小事来讲，就是轶事。

root: 希腊语 an-（不）+ ekdidonai（发表），名词 anekdota（未发表之物）；核心义是「原本私藏、后来讲出来的真实小故事」

sensesIntro.en: The senses move from a real short story, to unverified talk, to a story used as an example, to a whole collection of such stories.
sensesIntro.cn: 这些义项从真实的短故事，走到未经证实的传闻，再走到用作例证的故事，最后是整部故事集。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small true story told around a table
core.cn: 核心意象：围坐桌边讲出的一件真实小事

branches.en: A real incident becomes a short spoken story.
branches.cn: 真实事件变成简短的讲述故事。

branches.en: Word of mouth turns the story into unverified gossip.
branches.cn: 口耳相传把故事变成未经证实的传闻。

branches.en: A speaker uses the story to make an idea concrete.
branches.cn: 演讲者用故事把观念讲得具体。

branches.en: Many stories together form a collection.
branches.cn: 许多故事合在一起成为合集。

branches.en: The same story can entertain and explain at once.
branches.cn: 同一个故事可以同时娱乐与说明。

intro.en: The word is built from Greek negative and publishing pieces, with the adjective, adverb, and person endings -al, -ly, and -ist.
intro.cn: 这个词由希腊语的否定成分与「发表」成分构成，并带形容词、副词与人物后缀 -al、-ly、-ist。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor; the word is Greek in origin, and the Latin entries are left empty rather than inventing a form.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语祖先；这个词源自希腊语，因此拉丁条目留空，而不编造形式。

derivatives.zh: 形容词，义为「轶事式的；传闻的」
名词，义为「爱讲轶事的人」

definition_zh: 贫血；贫血症；（比喻）缺乏活力、萎靡不振
definition_en: a condition in which the blood lacks enough healthy red cells, causing weakness; a lack of vitality
core_image: 脸色苍白、爬两层楼就喘的人：血里少了提气的红细胞
scene: 她最近总是头晕，爬楼梯都费劲。The doctor said her constant fatigue was caused by anemia, so she needed more iron in her diet.
sceneCN: 这里的 anemia 是「贫血症」（第 1 个义项：血液中健康红细胞不足）；句意是医生说她持续的疲劳由贫血引起，需要补铁。

derivatives.zh: 由 anemia 加形容词后缀 -ic 构成，义为「贫血的；苍白无力的」
由 anemic 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「贫血地；苍白无力地」

senses.title: A lack of healthy red blood cells
senses.definition: a medical condition in which the blood has too few healthy red cells or too little hemoglobin, causing tiredness and pallor
senses.definitionCN: 血液中健康红细胞或血红蛋白过少的病症，导致疲倦、脸色苍白
senses.example: Heavy periods are a common cause of anemia in young women.
senses.exampleCN: 月经过多是年轻女性贫血的常见原因。
senses.why: The Greek prefix an- means without and haima means blood, so the term literally names a bloodless, blood-poor state.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语前缀 an- 表示「没有」，haima 表示「血」，术语字面就是「缺血、血少」的状态。

senses.title: A lack of vitality or strength
senses.definition: a weakness or lack of vigor in something such as an economy, a team, or a piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 比喻经济、队伍、文章等缺乏生气与力度
senses.example: The report described the anemia of the housing market.
senses.exampleCN: 报告描述了房地产市场的萎靡不振。
senses.why: A pale, tired patient gave writers a ready image of weak, colorless performance, so the medical word turned figurative.
senses.whyCN: 苍白疲倦的病人给写作者提供了现成的「无力、无血色」意象，医学术语因此转出比喻义。

intro.en: Anemia is a Greek medical compound: an- without plus haima blood.
intro.cn: anemia 是希腊医学复合词：an-（没有）加 haima（血）。

items.en: The reconstructed root *ai- or *sai- referred to vital fluid; its descendants include haima and related blood words.
items.cn: 重构词根 *ai- / *sai- 与生命液体有关，其后续形式包括希腊语 haima 等表示「血」的词。

items.en: Greek haima meant blood, and the compound anaimia named the condition of being without blood, that is, blood-poor.
items.cn: 希腊语 haima 意为「血」，复合词 anaimia 表示「无血、缺血」的状态。

items.en: Medical Latin revived the compound as anaemia when doctors systematized Greek terms.
items.cn: 医生们系统化希腊术语时，医学拉丁语以 anaemia 复兴了这个复合词。

items.en: English anemia is recorded from the early 1800s in medical writing.
items.cn: 英语 anemia 自 19 世纪初见于医学文献。

items.en: By the late 19th century the word had also taken the figurative sense of any lack of vigor.
items.cn: 到 19 世纪后期，该词也发展出「缺乏活力」的比喻义。

note.en: Anemia is often confused with anorexia in form; its adjectives anemic and anaemic differ by spelling system.
note.cn: anemia 易与 anorexia 在字形上混淆；形容词 anemic 与 anaemic 是美式与英式拼法。

normalIntro.en: Remember anemia as an- plus haima, without blood.
normalIntro.cn: 把 anemia 记成 an- 加 haima，就是「缺血」。

normal.en: an- means without, seen in anonymous and anarchy.
normal.cn: 前缀 an- 表示「没有」，见于 anonymous、anarchy。

normal.en: haima is the Greek word for blood, kept in hemoglobin.
normal.cn: haima 是希腊语「血」，保留在 hemoglobin（血红蛋白）一词中。

normal.en: So anemia literally means a blood-poor state.
normal.cn: 所以 anemia 字面意思就是「血少」的状态。

normal.en: hematology, the study of blood, shares the same root.
normal.cn: hematology（血液学）用的就是同一个「血」词根。

normal.en: The adjective anemic also means weak or unimpressive.
normal.cn: 形容词 anemic 也表示「软弱无力的、不痛不痒的」。

abstract.en: Picture a pale runner who has to stop halfway up the stairs.
abstract.cn: 想象一个脸色苍白的跑者，爬楼梯爬到一半就停下了。

abstract.en: See a wilting plant that has not been watered for weeks.
abstract.cn: 想象一株几周没浇水的植物，蔫蔫地垂着。

abstract.en: Feel a flat, colorless speech that puts the whole room to sleep.
abstract.cn: 感受一场苍白无力的演讲，让全场昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: She was diagnosed with iron-deficiency anemia last winter.
examples.cn: 去年冬天她被诊断出缺铁性贫血。

examples.en: An anemic performance in the first half cost the team the match.
examples.cn: 上半场软绵绵的表现让球队输掉了比赛。

examples.en: Common symptoms of anemia include dizziness and pale skin.
examples.cn: 贫血的常见症状包括头晕和面色苍白。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额·腻·咪·呀」——额头像抹了腻子一样没有血色，咪着眼喊呀好累：anemia，贫血。

root: 希腊语否定前缀 an-（无）+ haima（血，词根 *ai-/*sai- 与生命液体相关）→ anaimia「缺血状态」，经医学拉丁语 anaemia 进入英语。同族词 hemoglobin（血红蛋白）、hematology（血液学）。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the blood condition to the figurative lack of vigor.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从「血液病症」出发，引申为「缺乏生气的比喻用法」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: blood gone thin, body gone pale and weak
core.cn: 核心意象：血变稀薄，人变得苍白无力

branches.en: The medical state of too few red cells
branches.cn: 红细胞过少的医学病症

branches.en: The visible signs of tiredness and pallor
branches.cn: 疲倦与苍白的外在表征

branches.en: Weak colorless performance by analogy
branches.cn: 类比而来的软弱无色的表现

branches.en: A sluggish economy or market
branches.cn: 萎靡的经济或市场

branches.en: From thin blood to thin energy
branches.cn: 从血薄到「气」薄的引申路径

intro.en: Anemia is a transparent Greek compound: negative prefix plus the blood root.
intro.cn: anemia 是透明的希腊语复合词：否定前缀加「血」词根。

latinIntro.en: The haim- family of Greek medical words is large and systematic.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊医学词的 haim- 词族庞大而系统。
